66434.recognize_zh: 一顆比周圍小淋巴球大上數倍的巨大組織球，小而深染的細胞核偏在一側，細胞質豐富、淡藍色，呈纖細條紋狀、像揉皺的面紙（crumpled tissue paper）；這種細胞質紋理是高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）的特徵。
features: Very large round histiocyte, many times the size of the adjacent small lymphocytes
Small, eccentric, dense nucleus with irregular contour; low N:C ratio
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with fine fibrillary striations giving a crumpled tissue paper or wrinkled silk texture
No discrete cytoplasmic vacuoles, granules, or phagocytosed cells
Adjacent small mature lymphoid/erythroid cells for scale; smudged background material
66434.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a very large histiocyte adjacent to two small mononuclear cells. The histiocyte has a small, dense, eccentrically placed nucleus and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with a fine fibrillary, striated texture resembling crumpled tissue paper. No foamy vacuolation, sea-blue granules, or phagocytosed hematopoietic cells are identified. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme activity or GBA1 genetic testing is recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar, so they are separated by the underlying disorder and normal glucocerebrosidase activity; mycobacterial pseudo-Gaucher cells are AFB-positive.
Niemann-Pick cells have uniformly foamy, soap-bubble vacuolated cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green ceroid granules rather than a fine wrinkled cytoplasmic texture.
Megakaryocytes have large lobulated nuclei and finely granular pink cytoplasm with platelet budding, not a small eccentric nucleus with striated cytoplasm.

66306.recognize_zh: 這是臨床照片而非切片：雙側小腿可見不規則、網狀邊緣的紫黑色壞死斑塊（retiform purpura），中央有黑色焦痂與潰瘍、黃色腐肉，周邊有紅紫色邊緣；這種網狀紫斑合併壞死提示皮膚小血管血栓，需考慮 PNH 等血栓性疾病。
features: Large, irregular retiform (branching, angulated-edge) purpuric plaques on both lower legs
Central dusky violaceous to black necrosis with eschar formation
Ulceration with yellow fibrinous slough and exposed pink granulation tissue in the right leg lesion
Violaceous to erythematous hemorrhagic borders with superficial desquamation
Multiple separate lesions (upper left and lower left fields), indicating a multifocal process
66306.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the posterior lower legs shows multiple large, irregular retiform purpuric plaques with angulated, branching borders. The lesions have central violaceous-black necrosis with eschar and an area of ulceration covered by yellow fibrinous slough, surrounded by a dusky erythematous hemorrhagic rim. No histology is shown in this image, so dermal vessel thrombosis itself is not directly visualized; the title refers to the biopsy findings. The clinical pattern of retiform purpura with necrosis indicates occlusive cutaneous microvascular thrombosis and, in the context of a large GPI-deficient granulocyte clone, is consistent with thrombotic complications of paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria.

ddx.vs: Produces identical retiform purpura with dermal thrombi; lupus anticoagulant and anticardiolipin/anti-beta2-glycoprotein I antibodies rather than a FLAER-negative clone establish the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Warfarin-induced skin necrosis or purpura fulminans (protein C/S deficiency)
ddx.vs: Temporal relation to warfarin initiation or sepsis with DIC and low protein C/S activity distinguish it; skin biopsy shows similar thrombi.
Occurs in end-stage renal disease and biopsy shows medial calcification of small subcutaneous arterioles rather than bland dermal thrombi alone.
Biopsy shows fibrinoid necrosis of vessel walls with neutrophilic infiltration and nuclear dust rather than intraluminal thrombi without vasculitis.

66370.recognize_zh: 上方中央一顆組織球的細胞質被數十顆有透明暈的小圓形酵母體塞滿，周圍骨髓背景中也到處散在同樣的小體；細胞內外皆有、帶透明暈與偏心紫點的 2–4 µm 小酵母，是組織漿菌侵犯骨髓的典型所見。
features: Histiocyte in the upper center packed with dozens of small round-to-oval yeast forms, each with a clear halo
Numerous identical extracellular yeasts scattered among hematopoietic cells, some in small clusters
Organisms are uniform, about 2-4 um, with an eccentric purple crescent or dot; no kinetoplast
Cellular aspirate with erythroid and myeloid precursors and a mitotic figure in the upper left
Scattered fat vacuoles and fine granular purple background debris
66370.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with erythroid and granulocytic precursors, a mitotic figure, and scattered fat vacuoles. A histiocyte in the upper center is distended by dozens of small, uniform, round-to-oval organisms, each with a clear halo and an eccentric crescent of purple-staining cytoplasm. Identical organisms are scattered extracellularly throughout the field, singly and in small clusters. No kinetoplasts are identified. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by disseminated histoplasmosis; GMS stain, culture, or antigen testing is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes contain a kinetoplast beside the nucleus and lack the clear pseudocapsular halo seen here.
Talaromyces shows elongated yeasts dividing by a transverse septum rather than uniform oval budding yeasts.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size (4-10 um) with a thick capsule that is mucicarmine-positive.
Candida glabrata is slightly larger with less distinct halos and is distinguished definitively by culture.

65666.recognize_zh: CSF 細胞離心抹片在低倍（1a）呈高度細胞性；高倍（1b–1f）可見大量含粗大深紫黑色顆粒、常遮蓋細胞核的嗜鹼性球，與核質比高、細緻染色質、淡藍色細胞質的大型母細胞混雜，在 CML 病人身上提示中樞神經的髓性急性轉變合併嗜鹼性球增生。
features: Panel 1a (low power): markedly cellular CSF cytospin with innumerable nucleated cells
Numerous basophils with coarse, dark purple-black granules that overlie and obscure the nucleus, some degranulating
Large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to indented nuclei, fine open chromatin and occasional nucleoli (panels 1c, 1e, 1f)
Blast cytoplasm is pale to moderately basophilic, some containing a few coarse basophilic granules
Occasional cells with reddish-purple granules and intermediate maturation (basophilic precursors)
65666.describe_en: CSF cytospin preparation is markedly hypercellular at low power. At high power, the cellular population consists of numerous basophils with coarse, dark metachromatic-appearing granules that obscure nuclear detail, admixed with large blasts showing high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and pale basophilic cytoplasm, some with sparse coarse granules. No normal CSF lymphocyte/monocyte background predominates. In a patient with CML, the findings are consistent with CNS involvement by myeloid blast phase with prominent basophilic differentiation.

ddx.vs: Mast cells have a round central non-lobed nucleus with evenly distributed granules and are tryptase/CD117 bright and CD123 weak, whereas basophils have lobulated nuclei obscured by coarse granules and are CD123+/CD203c+/HLA-DR−.
APL promyelocytes have azurophilic reddish granules with Auer rod bundles and bilobed nuclei, not dark metachromatic basophilic granules.

ddx.dx: Blood contamination (traumatic tap) in CML chronic phase
ddx.vs: A traumatic tap would show numerous RBCs and a mixed granulocytic spectrum mirroring blood, rather than a hypercellular population dominated by blasts and basophils.
Morphologically identical; distinction depends on prior CML history and BCR::ABL1 detection.

66114.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的三顆紅血球比周圍紅血球大、形狀為飽滿的卵圓形、中央淡染區不明顯，屬巨卵圓形紅血球（macro-ovalocyte）；整個視野以卵圓形紅血球為主並有少數淚滴狀細胞，提示巨母紅血球性變化。
features: Several enlarged oval red cells (arrows) larger than neighboring cells, some with slightly paler staining
Macro-ovalocytes lack a well-defined central pallor
Background shows numerous oval red cells, occasional teardrop cells and a few small irregular forms
No nucleated red cells, inclusions or leukocytes in field; occasional platelets
66114.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with a predominance of oval red cells, occasional teardrop cells and a few small irregular forms. Several macro-ovalocytes (arrows) are noticeably larger than adjacent red cells and lack distinct central pallor. No red cell inclusions or nucleated red cells are seen in this field. Findings are suggestive of megaloblastic change despite a normal MCV, which may be masked by a coexisting microcytic population; correlation with RDW, B12 and folate levels is recommended.

ddx.vs: These macrocytes are round and often accompanied by target cells or stomatocytes, rather than oval and fully hemoglobinized.
Elliptocytes are normocytic and uniformly elongated, and SAO cells show one or two transverse slits, unlike scattered large oval cells.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic syndrome or drug effect (hydroxyurea, methotrexate)
ddx.vs: These produce similar macro-ovalocytes with normal B12/folate levels, distinguished by drug history or marrow dysplasia.

66050.recognize_zh: 上方高倍視野可見細胞質富含空泡的巨噬細胞吞噬紅血球碎片及有核細胞（hemophagocytosis），背景紅血球呈錢串狀（rouleaux）；下方低倍視野為散在的非典型漿細胞（含雙核者）及藍染蛋白背景，符合 IgM 骨髓瘤合併噬血症候群。
features: Upper panels: large macrophages with abundant foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm containing ingested nuclear material and cellular debris
Upper right: macrophage engulfing intact nucleated cells (dense round nuclei within cytoplasm)
Prominent red cell rouleaux in the background of the upper panels
Lower panels: scattered plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and abundant basophilic cytoplasm, including binucleate forms
Lower panels: bluish-purple proteinaceous background staining consistent with a high paraprotein level
Overall paucity of normal hematopoietic cells in the lower panels
66050.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows multiple macrophages with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing phagocytosed nuclear debris and intact nucleated cells, indicating hemophagocytosis. Red cells in the background show rouleaux formation. At lower magnification, there are scattered atypical plasma cells, some binucleate, with abundant basophilic cytoplasm on a bluish proteinaceous background, while normal trilineage hematopoiesis appears sparse. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with associated hemophagocytosis, supporting secondary (malignancy-associated) hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in the appropriate clinical and laboratory context.

ddx.vs: LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P, whereas IgM myeloma has a pure plasma cell population, often with t(11;14) or other myeloma translocations.
Morphology is identical; primary HLH is separated by young age, family history and pathogenic variants in PRF1, UNC13D, STX11 or STXBP2, without an underlying neoplasm.

Occasional macrophages ingesting red cells or debris are nonspecific; HLH requires meeting clinical and laboratory criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, sCD25, hypertriglyceridemia/hypofibrinogenemia).
Storage-type histiocytes contain striated or granular material from high cell turnover rather than engulfed intact nucleated cells.

65922.recognize_zh: 中央一個卵圓形、幾乎填滿整顆宿主紅血球的圓形寄生蟲，細胞質呈藍紫色並散布深色顆粒/色素，未見分裂成裂殖子，也不是鐮刀形；這種圓形、充滿紅血球的型態符合間日瘧的配子體（macrogametocyte）。
features: Single rounded-oval parasite that fills essentially the entire host red cell
Dense blue-purple cytoplasm with diffusely scattered dark granules/pigment
No segmentation into merozoites (not a schizont); no crescent shape
Host cell outline roughly the size of neighboring red cells in this image; Schüffner dots not discernible because the parasite fills the cell
Background red cells with tapered spreading artifact; small platelet nearby
65922.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows a single round-to-oval parasite that fills the host red cell, with dense blue-purple cytoplasm, scattered dark pigment granules and no segmentation into merozoites. It is not crescent-shaped, excluding a P. falciparum gametocyte. The host cell does not appear dramatically enlarged in this field, and Schüffner dots cannot be assessed because the parasite occupies the whole cell, so species assignment rests on accompanying stages in the smear. Findings are consistent with a round gametocyte, supporting Plasmodium vivax in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum gametocytes are banana- or crescent-shaped rather than round.
A schizont contains 12–24 discrete merozoites with clumped pigment, whereas this parasite shows undivided cytoplasm with scattered pigment.
These are also round but occupy normal-sized (P. malariae) or oval fimbriated (P. ovale) red cells; separation often requires the other stages or PCR.

65858.recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球的核是兩個大小相近的圓形葉，中間以極細的染色質絲相連，像夾鼻眼鏡（pince-nez），染色質緻密粗塊狀，細胞質顆粒明顯；這是 Pelger-Huët 型雙葉嗜中性球的教科書樣貌。
features: Neutrophil with a symmetric bilobed nucleus: two round lobes connected by a thin filament (pince-nez)
Dense, coarsely clumped chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm with conspicuous neutrophilic granules
Background red cells with refractile drying artifact; scattered platelets and a platelet clump
65858.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a symmetric bilobed nucleus composed of two round lobes joined by a thin chromatin filament (pince-nez configuration), with coarse clumped chromatin and well-granulated cytoplasm. Red cells show drying artifact and platelets are present. This represents a Pelger-Huët-type hyposegmented neutrophil; given the reported reactive leukocytosis due to infection, findings are consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huët change, with inherited anomaly and myelodysplasia to be excluded clinically.

ddx.vs: Identical morphology; the inherited form involves nearly all neutrophils lifelong and is present in relatives.
MDS-related pseudo-Pelger cells are usually hypogranular and accompanied by cytopenias and other dysplastic changes.
A band nucleus is a continuous curved band of even width with less condensed chromatin, without two round lobes joined by a filament.

65090.recognize_zh: 20 倍下以小型成熟淋巴球為主的濾泡中，散在幾個核較大、染色質淡而空泡狀、核形不規則或多葉的細胞，並有一條穿入的小血管；這些核大且不規則的細胞就是發育異常的濾泡樹突細胞（dysplastic FDC），出現在萎縮的生發中心，是透明血管型 Castleman 病的線索。
features: Follicular area dominated by small round mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin
Scattered large cells with enlarged, vesicular, irregular to multilobated nuclei and delicate nuclear membranes (dysplastic follicular dendritic cells)
Occasional binucleate-appearing FDCs with small nucleoli and ill-defined pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Small penetrating capillary with plump endothelial cells within the follicle
Absence of tingible-body macrophages, mitotic activity and centroblast-rich germinal center
65090.describe_en: Lymph node section at higher power shows a follicle composed predominantly of small mature lymphocytes surrounding a lymphocyte-depleted germinal center. Within the germinal center are scattered follicular dendritic cells with enlarged, vesicular, irregular or lobated nuclei, occasional binucleation and indistinct cytoplasm, accompanied by a small penetrating vessel. Tingible-body macrophages and centroblasts are not conspicuous, and no sheets of atypical cells are present. Findings are consistent with a regressed germinal center with dysplastic follicular dendritic cells, as seen in unicentric hyaline-vascular Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: FDC sarcoma shows cohesive sheets or whorls of atypical CD21/CD23/CD35+ spindle cells effacing architecture, rather than scattered dysplastic FDCs within intact follicles.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells have huge eosinophilic macronucleoli and are CD30+/CD15+ in an inflammatory background, unlike the bland small nucleoli of dysplastic FDCs.
Reactive germinal centers are cellular with centroblasts, centrocytes, mitoses and tingible-body macrophages, with only inconspicuous FDCs.

65154.recognize_zh: 腹水抹片中一小團三顆大細胞，細胞質被大型淡染空泡撐滿，深染細胞核被擠成新月形貼在細胞邊緣，呈典型印戒細胞（signet ring cell）外觀，且細胞成團聚集，提示轉移性腺癌。
features: Small cohesive cluster of three large cells, several times the size of a lymphocyte
Large pale, finely vacuolated intracytoplasmic mucin vacuoles occupying most of each cell
Dense hyperchromatic nuclei compressed into crescents at the cell periphery (signet ring configuration)
Deeply basophilic rim of cytoplasm with sharp, smooth cell borders
Clean, paucicellular background without inflammatory cells in this field
65154.describe_en: Cytospin of ascitic fluid shows a small three-dimensional cluster of large atypical cells in a clean background. The cells contain large pale intracytoplasmic vacuoles that indent and displace hyperchromatic nuclei into crescentic shapes at the periphery, imparting a signet ring appearance. Cohesion of the cells favors an epithelial rather than mesothelial or hematolymphoid origin. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma with signet ring cell features; mucin stains and an immunocytochemical panel are needed to confirm and to explore the primary site.

ddx.dx: Reactive mesothelial cells with degenerative vacuoles
ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells have central round nuclei, dense two-tone cytoplasm with a lacy edge and 'windows' between cells, whereas true signet ring cells show a single large mucin vacuole indenting the nucleus; calretinin/WT1 positivity versus MOC-31/BerEP4 positivity separates them.
Macrophages are dispersed singly with bean-shaped nuclei and foamy multivacuolated cytoplasm, lack three-dimensional cohesion, and are CD68/CD163 positive and mucicarmine negative.

ddx.dx: Signet ring lymphoma or plasma cells with Russell bodies
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are non-cohesive, and their vacuoles contain immunoglobulin rather than mucin, which is confirmed by CD45 and light-chain staining with keratin negativity.

65026.recognize_zh: 這張是流式細胞儀圖而非血片：以低 FSC/SSC 設定淋巴球閘門（R1 約 75%），CD5 陽性約 97%、CD19 陽性約 91%，雙參數圖中大部分細胞位於 CD5+CD19+ 象限，CD23 陽性約 76%，符合 CLL 的 CD5+/CD23+ B 細胞表現型；標題描述的塗抹細胞在此圖看不到。
features: Flow cytometry panel, not a morphologic image; smudge cells from the case description are not shown
FSC vs SSC plot: lymphocyte gate R1 of small, low side-scatter cells comprising ~74.8% of events
CD5 (FITC) histogram ~97.5% positive and CD19 (PE) histogram ~91% positive within R1
CD5 vs CD19 dot plot: dominant CD5+CD19+ double-positive population (value truncated, ~9x%), with few CD5+CD19- T cells
CD23 (PE) ~76% positive, with a broad dim-to-moderate expression peak
65026.describe_en: This figure shows flow cytometric analysis rather than smear morphology. Within a lymphocyte gate of small, low side-scatter cells (about 75% of events), the great majority of cells coexpress CD5 and CD19 (CD5 about 97%, CD19 about 91%, with a dominant double-positive quadrant), and about 76% express CD23. The scarcity of CD5+CD19- T cells indicates replacement by an aberrant CD5+ B-cell population. Light chain restriction, CD20/surface immunoglobulin intensity, CD200 and FMC7 are not shown and are needed for a complete score. The immunophenotype is consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia in keeping with the smear findings described.

ddx.vs: MCL is also CD5+CD19+ but usually CD23 negative, CD200 negative/dim and FMC7 positive with bright CD20 and surface immunoglobulin, and it expresses cyclin D1/SOX11 with t(11;14).
MBL has the same phenotype, so it is distinguished only by an absolute clonal B-cell count below 5 x10^9/L without lymphadenopathy, organomegaly or cytopenias.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma or lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma with CD5 expression
ddx.vs: These CD5+ variants are typically CD23 negative with CD200 negative and bright surface immunoglobulin, and have a low Matutes score, unlike the CD23-positive population here.

64962.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心片中有多顆空泡狀巨噬細胞：B 細胞內含金黃色菱形結晶（血晶/hematoidin 類結晶），A 與 C 細胞含黑藍色含鐵血黃素顆粒（siderophage），背景有嗜中性球，提示先前出血而非單純穿刺造成的新鮮血。
features: Macrophage (B) containing a refractile golden-yellow rhomboid crystal, consistent with hematin/hematoidin crystal
Macrophages (A, C) with vacuolated cytoplasm containing coarse dark blue-black hemosiderin granules (siderophages)
Macrophage A with an eccentric reniform nucleus and phagocytic vacuoles
Several segmented neutrophils and an occasional lymphocyte in the background
Background of numerous red cell ghosts consistent with hemorrhagic CSF
64962.describe_en: Cytospin of cerebrospinal fluid shows a mixed cell population with increased macrophages among neutrophils and occasional lymphocytes on a background of abundant red cells. Several macrophages are vacuolated and contain coarse dark hemosiderin granules (siderophages, A and C), and one macrophage contains a golden-yellow rhomboid crystal (B), consistent with a hematin/hematoidin-type crystal. These findings indicate breakdown of red cells over days and are not expected from a traumatic tap alone. Findings are consistent with subacute to chronic hemorrhage into the CSF.

ddx.vs: A traumatic tap shows fresh red cells without erythrophages, siderophages or hematoidin crystals, and red cell counts decrease across sequential tubes.
Melanin is brown-black fine pigment that is Prussian blue negative, often with atypical melanoma cells, whereas hemosiderin is Prussian blue positive.
Hematoidin crystals are bright golden-yellow rhomboid or needle forms within macrophages and are iron-negative, unlike colorless extracellular contaminant crystals.
Meningitis shows predominant neutrophils with possible intracellular organisms and low CSF glucose, without prominent pigment-laden macrophages.

64770.recognize_zh: 同一張骨髓切片中，骨小樑左側仍是正常造血骨髓，右側則被纖維增生（desmoplastic）間質取代，內有黏聚成巢、細胞質嗜酸性、核大且有核仁的上皮細胞，這種「異物般成巢的黏聚細胞」即轉移性癌的線索。
features: Sharp contrast between residual normocellular trilineage hematopoietic marrow (left) and a tumor-replaced intertrabecular space (right)
Cohesive nests and anastomosing cords of large polygonal epithelial cells with moderate to abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Enlarged pleomorphic vesicular nuclei with conspicuous nucleoli
Surrounding desmoplastic/fibrotic stroma with loss of fat and hematopoietic elements
Intervening bone trabecula without significant osteoblastic rimming in this field
64770.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a bony trabecula separating residual hematopoietic marrow with trilineage elements from an intertrabecular space extensively replaced by desmoplastic stroma. Within the stroma are cohesive nests and cords of large polygonal cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, pleomorphic vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, foreign to the marrow. Definite keratin pearls are not evident in this field. In a patient with known squamous cell carcinoma, the findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, compatible with squamous cell carcinoma; confirmation with p40/p63 and cytokeratin immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Adenocarcinoma forms glands or shows mucin vacuoles and is typically CK7/TTF-1/CDX2 positive, whereas squamous carcinoma forms solid nests with dense eosinophilic cytoplasm, keratinization and p40/p63 positivity.
Megakaryocytes are single large lobulated cells and osteoblasts line trabeculae with eccentric nuclei and a hof, unlike cohesive nests of atypical epithelial cells in desmoplastic stroma.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma or large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Hematolymphoid tumors infiltrate as discohesive sheets without desmoplastic nests and are cytokeratin negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic melanoma or small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Melanoma is S100/SOX10 positive and small round cell tumors have scant cytoplasm, unlike keratin-positive polygonal cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm.

64322.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎整片都是大型漿細胞：核圓而偏位、染色質較細或呈車輪狀，細胞質豐富、灰藍色且有細小空泡，細胞密集成片，只殘留少數嗜中性球前驅細胞，顯示骨髓被漿細胞大量浸潤。
features: Sheets of large plasma cells replacing the aspirate, dominating nearly all nucleated cells
Round, eccentric nuclei with moderately fine to clock-face chromatin; small nucleoli in some cells
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuolation; perinuclear hof not prominent in many cells
Mild variation in nuclear size with occasional immature-appearing forms
Scattered residual granulocytic precursors and neutrophils; small clear vacuoles and gray proteinaceous background
64322.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of large plasma cells effacing the normal hematopoietic elements. The plasma cells have round, eccentric nuclei with moderately fine to clock-face chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and abundant gray-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm; perinuclear hofs are inconspicuous in many cells. Only scattered residual granulocytic precursors and neutrophils are present, set in a gray proteinaceous background. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by plasma cell myeloma; quantification, CD138 and kappa/lambda studies, and cytogenetics/FISH are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells rarely exceed 10-20%, are small and mature with distinct hofs and are polytypic, unlike these sheets of large atypical plasma cells.
Plasmablastic lymphoma cells have larger nuclei with prominent central nucleoli and high N:C ratio, usually with EBER positivity and an extramedullary presentation.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei, fine lacy chromatin and granular gray cytoplasm and are CD138-negative, CD14/CD64-positive.
LPL contains a mixture of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with fewer mature plasma cells, not uniform sheets of large plasma cells.

64450.recognize_zh: 低倍視野中散在數個小型、核圓而深染、周圍有粉紅至灰藍細胞質的有核紅血球（NRBC），背景紅血球大小不一，夾雜緻密無淡染區的小球形紅血球與偏藍的多染性紅血球。
features: Scattered nucleated red blood cells with small, round, dense pyknotic nuclei and pink to grey-blue cytoplasm
Anisocytosis with admixed small dense red cells lacking central pallor (spherocytes)
Larger bluish-grey polychromatic red cells
Leukocytes sparse in this field
Dark irregular purple-black clumps consistent with stain precipitate or platelet clumps
Low magnification limits assessment of fine nuclear and cytoplasmic detail
64450.describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows scattered nucleated red blood cells with small dense nuclei and pink to grey-blue cytoplasm. Background red cells show anisocytosis with spherocytes and polychromatic cells. Dark precipitate or platelet clumps are present as artifact, and detailed cytology is limited by the magnification. In a patient with prostate cancer and 24% nucleated red cells, findings raise concern for a leukoerythroblastic process related to marrow infiltration or a hemolytic process; correlation with a full smear review for immature granulocytes and teardrop cells and marrow evaluation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a thin rim of blue cytoplasm and less pyknotic chromatin, whereas NRBCs have orthochromic pink or polychromatic cytoplasm around a very dense round nucleus.

ddx.dx: Leukoerythroblastosis from marrow infiltration or myelofibrosis
ddx.vs: This is a cause rather than a mimic, identified by accompanying immature granulocytes and teardrop cells on a full smear review and confirmed by marrow biopsy.
Hemolysis produces NRBCs with marked polychromasia and spherocytes, and is supported by elevated LDH, bilirubin, reticulocytes, and a positive DAT if immune.

64386.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指為一顆比周圍造血細胞大數倍的組織球樣細胞，細胞質豐富、淡紫灰色並散佈許多細小空泡，界線模糊，提示儲積型組織球；但 Gaucher 細胞典型的「皺紋紙」纖維紋路在此失焦影像中並不明顯。
features: Very large cell (several times the size of adjacent precursors) with abundant pale lilac-gray cytoplasm
Cytoplasm with numerous tiny clear vacuoles/refractile dots and faint granular texture; fibrillary striations not clearly resolved
Nucleus poorly defined, appearing as a central darker zone
Ill-defined cell border blending with the smear background
Background erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and granulocytic cells; image out of focus
64386.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocytic cell (arrow) with abundant pale lilac-gray cytoplasm containing numerous fine vacuoles and a poorly defined nucleus, surrounded by erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and granulocytic cells. The classic crumpled tissue-paper fibrillary cytoplasm of a Gaucher cell is not clearly demonstrated, and the image is out of focus. Findings suggest a storage-type histiocyte; in the stated clinical context this may represent a Gaucher cell, with confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay and/or GBA1 genotyping.

ddx.vs: Foamy histiocytes have distinct bubbly vacuolated cytoplasm, which overlaps with the vacuolated appearance here, whereas Gaucher cells show striated wrinkled cytoplasm with PAS positivity.
Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML, myeloma or thalassemia are morphologically identical, and are distinguished by clinical context and normal enzyme activity.
Megakaryocytes have a large lobulated nucleus occupying much of the cell and granular cytoplasm, rather than a small indistinct nucleus with vacuolated pale cytoplasm.
Smudged cells lack an intact cytoplasmic membrane and show streaked nuclear material rather than a defined cytoplasm with vacuoles.

64130.recognize_zh: 數顆大型芽細胞具豐富嗜鹼性細胞質、細緻染色質，其中一顆可見核周淡染區（perinuclear hof），下方細胞細胞質大量但顆粒稀少（hypogranular），合乎 t(8;21) AML 的型態；細長 Auer 小體在此解析度下不易清楚辨認。
features: Large blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio, round to indented nuclei, and finely granular to open chromatin with nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm in the upper blasts, one with a pale perinuclear hof
Faint slender linear structure in the right-hand blast possibly representing a single Auer rod, not clearly resolved at this image resolution
Lower cell with abundant pale gray-blue hypogranular cytoplasm, a dysgranulopoietic feature
Adjacent small cell with a dense round nucleus and gray cytoplasm consistent with a late erythroid precursor
64130.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large myeloid blasts with fine nuclear chromatin, variably indented nuclei, and moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm, one displaying a distinct perinuclear hof. A faint slender linear inclusion suggestive of a single Auer rod may be present, although it is not clearly resolved at this image resolution. An adjacent maturing myeloid cell shows abundant hypogranular cytoplasm, and a late erythroid precursor is present nearby. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with maturation and dysgranulopoiesis, compatible with AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1 [t(8;21)] in the clinical context; cytogenetic or molecular confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: APL cells have bilobed or folded nuclei with abundant coarse granules or bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells) rather than single slender Auer rods with perinuclear hofs.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation without t(8;21) or MDS with increased blasts
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; t(8;21) is favored by large blasts with salmon-colored granules, single long Auer rods, and CD19/PAX5 aberrant expression, but karyotype or RUNX1::RUNX1T1 PCR is definitive.
inv(16) AML shows myelomonocytic differentiation with abnormal eosinophils containing large basophilic granules.
Plasma cells have clock-face chromatin, eccentric nuclei, and a hof but lack fine blastic chromatin and Auer rods, and are CD138 positive.

64194.recognize_zh: 周邊血片中可見多顆中到大型淋巴細胞，胞質中等量淡藍、核圓或略不規則、染色質中度凝集，部分細胞（如下方那顆）可見單一中央核仁；在 CLL 背景下出現大量這種帶核仁的前淋巴細胞（prolymphocyte），代表疾病進展。
features: Medium-to-large lymphoid cells, variable in size, about 2-3 times the diameter of red cells
Moderately abundant pale blue cytoplasm with lower N:C ratio than typical CLL cells
Round to oval or slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Single central nucleolus visible in some cells, most clearly in the lower cell; less distinct in others
Red cells show normal morphology; smudge cells not evident in this field
64194.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increased number of medium-to-large lymphoid cells with moderately abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm. Nuclei are round to slightly irregular with moderately condensed chromatin, and several cells display a single, centrally placed nucleolus. The cells vary in size, with larger cells having more cytoplasm. In a patient with known CLL/SLL, these features are consistent with prolymphocytic progression; prolymphocyte percentage should be quantified on a well-prepared film, and TP53 status assessed.

ddx.vs: MCL cells often have irregular or cleaved nuclei and are CD5+ CD23-negative with cyclin D1/SOX11 or t(11;14), which morphology alone cannot exclude.
SMZL cells are smaller with condensed chromatin and polar villous cytoplasmic projections, and are typically CD5-negative.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: Shows prominent nucleoli but with circumferential hairy cytoplasmic projections and CD103+/CD11c+ without CD25 or annexin A1.
T-PLL cells are smaller with deeply basophilic cytoplasmic blebs and are T-cell markers positive with TCL1A rearrangement.

64066.recognize_zh: 左圖骨髓抹片中數個巨噬細胞的細胞質塞滿粗大深綠褐至黑色顆粒狀包涵體；右圖鐵染色（Prussian blue）這些巨噬細胞內充滿藍綠色粗顆粒，代表鐵儲存增加。噬血現象在此視野中僅能看到可疑的被吞噬小核碎片，並不明確。
features: Left (Romanowsky): several macrophages with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm packed with coarse dark greenish-brown to black globular inclusions
Some macrophages contain small dark round bodies that may represent ingested nuclear material or platelets; unequivocal whole-cell hemophagocytosis is not clearly shown
Background of maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) and erythroid precursors, consistent with regenerating marrow
Right (Prussian blue): macrophages within a particle filled with coarse blue-green iron-positive granules admixed with some golden-brown globules
No blasts increase evident in the fields shown
64066.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a regenerating marrow with maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. There are increased macrophages with abundant cytoplasm containing coarse dark greenish-brown to black globular inclusions; some contain small dark bodies suspicious for ingested cellular material, although definite hemophagocytosis of intact cells is not unequivocal in this field. A Prussian blue stain of a marrow particle shows macrophages laden with coarse blue-green iron-positive granules admixed with golden-brown pigment, indicating increased storage iron. Findings are consistent with increased marrow iron stores in post-chemotherapy/transfusion setting with macrophage activation; residual pigmented globules that are not clearly iron-positive could reflect hemosiderin of variable staining or other ingested debris, and clinical correlation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Fungal elements appear as septate hyphae or conidia that are GMS/PAS positive and Prussian blue negative, whereas these globules are coarse, variably iron-positive and lack hyphal structures.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granules that are Prussian blue negative and PAS/Sudan black positive, whereas these macrophages show strong iron staining.
HLH requires convincing macrophage ingestion of intact erythrocytes, leukocytes or platelets together with clinical criteria, which cannot be established from this field alone.
Storage cells have striated or foamy cytoplasm rather than discrete coarse dark pigment globules.

64002.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中前臂皮膚有多條平行、橫向的淡紅色線狀紅斑，並伴隨褐色色素沉著區塊，呈鞭打狀排列，符合 bleomycin 引起的鞭狀皮膚炎及其後的發炎後色素沉著。
features: Multiple parallel, linear to curvilinear erythematous streaks across the forearm
Whip-like (flagellate) arrangement
Brownish post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, most prominent in the upper patch
A few small dark crusted points, possibly from scratching
No bullae, pustules, or ulceration
64002.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the forearm shows multiple parallel, linear and curvilinear erythematous macules and thin plaques in a whip-like distribution, with an adjacent area of brownish hyperpigmentation. A few small dark crusted foci are present, possibly related to pruritus and scratching, without bullae or ulceration. Histologic assessment is not possible from this image. In the setting of ABVD chemotherapy, findings are consistent with bleomycin-induced flagellate dermatitis evolving to hyperpigmentation.

ddx.vs: Excoriations consist of linear erosions and crusts along scratch lines, whereas flagellate dermatitis forms erythematous streaks that can appear without prior scratching.
Phytophotodermatitis follows plant-juice contact plus sun exposure with drip-shaped streaks in exposed areas, rather than widespread whip-like lesions including the trunk.
Dermatomyositis has associated heliotrope rash, Gottron papules, and myositis, which are absent in drug-induced flagellate dermatitis.

63938.recognize_zh: 薄層血片中紅血球之間有一條細長、彎成 C 字形的紫色鞭毛蟲體，位於細胞外而不在紅血球內，這種固定血片中的 C 形錐鞭毛體（trypomastigote）是克氏錐蟲（T. cruzi）的典型外觀。
features: Single slender, extracellular flagellate curved into a C shape between red cells
Purple-staining elongated body; nucleus and kinetoplast not clearly resolved at this magnification
Organism length roughly two to three red cell diameters
Nearby small purple clumped structure, most consistent with a platelet clump
Background red cells in a thick area with scattered dark rod-like stain precipitate and refractile artifacts
63938.describe_en: Giemsa-stained thin peripheral blood smear shows densely packed red cells with scattered stain precipitate and a small platelet clump. Between the red cells there is a single slender extracellular flagellate curved into a characteristic C shape, measuring roughly two to three red cell diameters in length; the nucleus and the terminal kinetoplast cannot be clearly resolved at this magnification. No intracellular parasites are seen. Findings are consistent with a Trypanosoma cruzi trypomastigote, which should be correlated with epidemiologic exposure and confirmed by PCR or serology.

ddx.vs: T. brucei trypomastigotes are longer and more undulating with a small subterminal kinetoplast and a prominent undulating membrane, rather than the C shape with a large terminal kinetoplast of T. cruzi.
T. rangeli is longer and thinner with a small kinetoplast and is non-pathogenic, often requiring PCR to separate it in co-endemic areas.
Microfilariae are much larger, many red cells long, with a column of nuclei and sometimes a sheath rather than a single nucleus and kinetoplast.
Artifacts lack an internal nucleus or kinetoplast and do not show the uniform tapered organism outline.

63810.recognize_zh: 組合圖：流式顯示 CD38+/CD138+、胞質 kappa 限制、CD20+/CD19− 的漿細胞；H&E 為成片小型、核略偏心的成熟樣漿細胞；IHC 顯示 CD138 膜染、BCL1（cyclin D1）核染與 CD20 膜染皆強陽性，符合小細胞型多發性骨髓瘤而非被 CD20/BCL1 誤導的 MCL。
features: Flow (A): CD38/CD138 double-positive plasma cells, cytoplasmic kappa restricted, CD20 positive and CD19 negative
H&E (B): diffuse sheets of small, monotonous cells with round, slightly eccentric nuclei and scant cytoplasm replacing marrow
CD138 IHC (C): strong membranous staining of nearly all cells
BCL1/cyclin D1 IHC (D): strong nuclear staining in the majority of cells
CD20 IHC (E): strong membranous staining in the neoplastic cells
Small lymphocyte-like size of the plasma cells mimics a B-cell lymphoma
63810.describe_en: This composite figure combines flow cytometry and bone marrow biopsy stains. Flow cytometry (A) identifies a plasma cell population that is CD38 and CD138 positive, cytoplasmic kappa restricted, CD20 positive and CD19 negative. The H&E-stained biopsy (B) shows diffuse sheets of small, monotonous cells with round, slightly eccentric nuclei that largely replace the marrow. Immunohistochemistry shows strong membranous CD138 (C), strong nuclear cyclin D1/BCL1 (D) and strong membranous CD20 (E) in the neoplastic cells. Together with an IgG M-spike and absence of t(11;14) on karyotype, findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma, small-cell (lymphoplasmacytoid) subtype, with aberrant CD20 and cyclin D1 co-expression rather than mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Cells are CD19, PAX5 and CD5 positive and CD138 negative with surface light chain, and SOX11 positivity and t(11;14) by FISH are typical.
Shows a spectrum of CD19+ lymphocytes with a separate plasma cell component, an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Contains CD19/PAX5-positive B cells alongside plasma cells and lacks cyclin D1.
Also often small/lymphoplasmacytoid, CD20+ and cyclin D1+; FISH is more sensitive than karyotype, so t(11;14) should still be excluded by FISH.

63810.stain: H&E; IHC: CD138, BCL1, CD20; flow

63746.recognize_zh: 這張血液抹片為低倍、細胞分散的薄區，僅見兩顆小型淋巴樣細胞（核深染、胞質少，其中一顆胞質略偏心呈漿細胞樣）與大量血小板；紅血球大多單個分開，此視野並未明顯看到描述中的錢串狀排列（rouleaux），辨識需在較厚區域與臨床 IgM 副蛋白對照。
features: Low-power thin area of smear with mostly separated red cells; rouleaux not convincingly demonstrated in this field
Two small lymphoid cells with dense, condensed nuclei and scant basophilic cytoplasm
One lymphoid cell with slightly eccentric nucleus suggestive of a plasmacytoid lymphocyte
Normocytic red cells with central pallor
Numerous platelets; no blasts identified
63746.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, viewed at low magnification in a thin area, shows two small lymphoid cells with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, one of which has a slightly eccentric nucleus suggestive of plasmacytoid differentiation. Red cells are largely separated with central pallor, and definite rouleaux formation is not well demonstrated in this particular field, although it may be evident in thicker areas of the smear. Platelets are numerous and no blasts are seen. The low magnification limits cytologic detail; findings are nonspecific but compatible with circulating lymphoplasmacytic cells in the context of known lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma / plasma cell leukemia
ddx.vs: Myeloma shows rouleaux with circulating mature or atypical plasma cells with perinuclear hof rather than small plasmacytoid lymphocytes.
CLL shows numerous small round lymphocytes with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, without plasmacytoid forms.
SMZL cells often show polar villous projections, and IgM paraprotein with rouleaux is less common.
Reactive forms are polyclonal and accompanied by a range of reactive lymphocytes without a paraprotein.

63682.recognize_zh: 視野右中處有一顆細胞，細胞質內塞滿多個大小相近、淡色圓形的球狀包涵體（Russell bodies），環繞著偏心的細胞核，呈葡萄串狀，這是含免疫球蛋白堆積的 Mott cell（葡萄細胞）。
features: Single plasma cell with cytoplasm distended by multiple round, pale, uniform globular inclusions (Russell bodies)
Globules arranged around a round nucleus, giving a grape-like or morula appearance
Background marrow with numerous myeloid precursors, band and segmented neutrophils
Scattered plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and pale perinuclear zones
Intense magenta color cast limits assessment of chromatin detail
63682.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular background of maturing granulocytic precursors and neutrophils with scattered plasma cells. One plasma cell contains numerous uniform, round, pale globular cytoplasmic inclusions surrounding the nucleus, consistent with Russell bodies in a Mott cell. The strong magenta color cast of the image limits evaluation of chromatin and cytoplasmic basophilia, and no sheets of atypical plasma cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a Mott cell, which can occur in reactive plasmacytosis as well as in plasma cell neoplasms; correlation with plasma cell percentage and clonality studies is needed.

ddx.dx: Vacuolated cells (e.g. Burkitt lymphoma or monocytes)
ddx.vs: Burkitt cell vacuoles are clear, empty lipid vacuoles in deeply basophilic cytoplasm without a plasma cell nucleus, whereas Russell bodies are solid, faintly staining immunoglobulin globules.
Hemophagocytes are larger with engulfed red cells, platelets or nuclear debris of varying size, not uniform round globules.
Dutcher bodies are single pale immunoglobulin inclusions overlying or invaginating the nucleus, whereas Mott cell globules are multiple and cytoplasmic.
Crystal-storing plasma cells contain needle- or rhomboid-shaped inclusions rather than round globules.

63618.recognize_zh: 整片紅血球偏小且中央淡染區擴大（microcytosis, hypochromia），大小與形態差異大，可見淚滴形、靶形、碎片與不規則形紅血球，這種明顯異形合併小球低色素的組合符合血紅素 H 病（HbH disease）。
features: Microcytic hypochromic red cells with widened central pallor
Marked anisocytosis and poikilocytosis
Teardrop cells, target cells and irregularly shaped fragmented forms
Occasional echinocytes/crenated cells and elongated forms
Scattered platelets; no nucleated red cells or leukocytes in this field
63618.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a predominantly microcytic hypochromic red cell population with marked anisocytosis and poikilocytosis. Teardrop cells, target cells, fragmented and irregularly shaped cells, and occasional echinocytes are present. Platelets are present and no nucleated red cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a thalassemia syndrome of intermediate severity and, in context, hemoglobin H disease; confirmation by supravital HbH inclusion preparation, hemoglobin fractionation and alpha-globin gene analysis is recommended.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows microcytic hypochromic cells with pencil cells but fewer target and teardrop cells, a high RDW with a low RBC count, low ferritin and no HbH inclusions.
Beta-thalassemia trait has milder poikilocytosis with a high RBC count and elevated HbA2, without HbH inclusions.
Alpha-thalassemia trait shows mild microcytosis with minimal poikilocytosis and only rare or absent HbH inclusions.
Beta-thalassemia major shows many nucleated red cells, basophilic stippling and elevated HbF rather than HbH.

63554.recognize_zh: 這是雙色雙融合（dual-color dual-fusion）FISH：DAPI 藍色細胞核內可見一個單獨紅點（ABL1）、一個單獨綠點（BCR），另外兩個紅綠重疊的黃白色融合訊號，即 1R1G2F 的陽性 BCR::ABL1 型態。
features: Single interphase nucleus counterstained with DAPI (blue)
One isolated red signal representing a normal ABL1 allele
One isolated green signal representing a normal BCR allele
Two red-green overlapping (yellow/white) fusion signals representing der(9) and der(22)
Signal pattern 1R1G2F, the classic positive pattern for t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)
63554.describe_en: Interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization using dual-color, dual-fusion translocation probes for ABL1 (red) and BCR (green) on a DAPI-counterstained nucleus. The nucleus shows one separate red signal, one separate green signal and two co-localized red-green fusion signals (1R1G2F pattern). This reflects a reciprocal BCR::ABL1 rearrangement with fusion signals on both derivative chromosomes 22 and 9. A single nucleus is not sufficient for scoring; the result must be based on the percentage of abnormal nuclei relative to the laboratory cutoff. Findings are consistent with BCR::ABL1 fusion, t(9;22)(q34;q11.2).

ddx.dx: Variant pattern with deletion of der(9) sequences
ddx.vs: Deletion of ABL1/BCR sequences on der(9) produces a 1R1G1F pattern, whereas two fusion signals are present here.
Chance colocalization of normal signals typically yields a single fusion, while two fusions with residual separate signals in a dual-fusion assay are specific for true translocation.
A normal nucleus shows 2R2G with no fused signals.

63490.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 骨髓切片中，碎片狀組織大多被密集深藍的小圓形細胞佔據，下方中央有一塊淡粉紅、細胞核淡化的區域，上方可見一小段骨小樑，呈現白血病浸潤合併局部壞死的低倍樣貌。
features: Fragmented, markedly hypercellular marrow tissue at low power
Diffuse sheets of small to intermediate hyperchromatic round cells
Focal pale eosinophilic area with faded nuclei and ghost cell outlines (lower center)
Bone trabecula fragment at the top of the field
Absence of recognizable fat and normal hematopoietic islands
63490.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow biopsy shows fragmented, hypercellular marrow with a fragment of bony trabecula. The intertrabecular space is replaced by sheets of small to intermediate cells with dark round nuclei. A focal pale eosinophilic area with faded nuclear staining and ghost-like cellular outlines is present, consistent with coagulative necrosis. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia with focal bone marrow necrosis; higher-power examination and immunohistochemistry are needed to characterize the infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Would show cohesive nests or desmoplastic stroma and be positive for non-hematopoietic markers rather than a discohesive sheet of blasts.
Mature lymphoma infiltrates are often paratrabecular or nodular with admixed residual hematopoiesis and lack TdT/CD34 blast markers.
Viable marrow at the edge would show normal trilineage hematopoiesis rather than a monotonous blast population.

63298.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，脂肪空泡之間的造血細胞裡有大量細胞質含鮮紅色粗顆粒的嗜酸性球及其前驅細胞（部分核仍呈圓形），中央可見一顆巨核細胞；嗜酸性球系明顯增加但無芽細胞聚集，是 HES 骨髓的表現。
features: Numerous eosinophilic myelocytes, metamyelocytes and mature eosinophils with coarse bright red cytoplasmic granules
Eosinophil precursors with round to indented nuclei alongside segmented forms, indicating full maturation
Single megakaryocyte in the center with normal-appearing lobulated nucleus
Background neutrophilic and erythroid precursors with scattered small lymphocytes; no sheets of blasts
Interspersed adipocytes and extravasated red cells
63298.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows marked eosinophilic hyperplasia, with abundant eosinophilic myelocytes, metamyelocytes and mature eosinophils containing coarse bright red granules. Maturation appears orderly, and neutrophilic and erythroid precursors and a morphologically unremarkable megakaryocyte are present. No increase in blasts, atypical mast cell aggregates, or discrete lymphoid infiltrates is evident in this field. The findings represent nonspecific eosinophilic hyperplasia; with the aberrant T-cell population identified by flow cytometry, they are consistent with the lymphocytic variant of hypereosinophilic syndrome.

ddx.vs: Marrow eosinophilic hyperplasia looks similar, but PDGFRA cases often have scattered spindled CD25+ mast cells and fibrosis and require FIP1L1-PDGFRA testing to exclude.
Would show compact aggregates of spindled mast cells highlighted by tryptase/CD117, which are not seen in this field.
Shows increased blasts with abnormal eosinophils bearing large basophilic-appearing granules, whereas no blast increase is evident here.

63234.recognize_zh: 剖半的大型實質腫塊，切面呈灰褐色、質地均勻，中央散在黃白色砂粒狀鈣化區與暗褐色出血灶；以縱膈腔孤立大腫塊的臨床背景，這種帶鈣化的切面符合 Castleman 病（hyaline-vascular 型常見中央鈣化）。
features: Bivalved, well-circumscribed, lobulated solid mass with a thin capsule-like rim
Homogeneous tan-gray, fleshy to firm cut surface
Central gritty yellow-white areas suggestive of calcification/ossification
Scattered dark brown-purple foci consistent with hemorrhage
No obvious necrotic cavitation or cystic change visible
63234.describe_en: Gross photograph of a bivalved, well-circumscribed lobulated mass. The cut surface is predominantly firm and tan-gray, with central gritty yellow-white areas suggestive of calcification or ossification and scattered dark brown foci of hemorrhage. No cystic change or grossly obvious necrosis is seen. The gross appearance is nonspecific but, in the context of a solitary mediastinal mass, is compatible with unicentric Castleman disease; histologic examination is required for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Thymoma typically shows lobules separated by white fibrous septa on cut surface, and histology shows epithelial cells with immature T cells rather than regressed follicles with hyalinized vessels.
Nodular sclerosis CHL shows broad fibrous bands dividing nodules and histology reveals Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+, CD15+), which are absent in Castleman disease.
Teratoma shows cystic spaces, hair, sebaceous material or cartilage/bone on gross, whereas Castleman disease is a solid lymphoid mass with only focal calcification.
Solitary fibrous tumor has a whorled white fibrous cut surface and STAT6-positive spindle cells histologically, unlike the lymphoid follicular architecture of Castleman disease.

63106.recognize_zh: CD31 強陽性地勾勒出病灶中呈結節狀、囊狀的血管腔與其內乳頭狀突起，左側白髓淋巴球為陰性；證明病灶為血管內皮來源，搭配 CD68 陽性即符合 littoral cell angioma。
features: Strong membranous CD31 staining outlining anastomosing and nodular vascular channels
Positive cells form papillary tufts and ring-like structures within cystic spaces
Blood-filled cystic lumen (upper right) lined by CD31-positive cells
Adjacent white pulp lymphocytes (left) negative, with only small vessels staining
Lesion is sharply demarcated from the lymphoid tissue
63106.describe_en: CD31 immunostain of spleen shows strong membranous staining of the cells lining the anastomosing and cystic vascular channels of the lesion, including papillary tufts projecting into lumens. The adjacent white pulp is negative apart from small vessels. The findings confirm the vascular nature of the lesion and, together with histiocytic marker expression, support littoral cell angioma.

ddx.vs: Both are CD31-positive, but hemangioma is also CD34-positive and lacks CD68/CD163/CD21 expression.
Angiosarcoma shares CD31 positivity but shows solid areas, atypia, high Ki-67 and infiltrative growth.
SANT nodules contain mixed CD34+ capillaries, CD8+ sinusoids and CD31-only veins within fibrous stroma.

62914.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見三個大型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，左側細胞的細胞質較多呈淡藍色並有淡染區；t(8;21) AML 的經典線索是核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof）與單一細長尖端的 Auer 小體，但此圖中 Auer 小體並不明確。
features: Large blasts with round nuclei and finely granular, open chromatin
High N:C ratio in two cells; left blast has more abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm with a paler zone adjacent to the nucleus
Faint linear streaking in the left blast cytoplasm, possibly representing a slender Auer rod, not definitively resolved
Nucleoli inconspicuous at this focus
Background red cells with some overlap/rouleaux-like stacking
62914.describe_en: High-power view of a smear shows three large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio. The left blast has a moderate rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm with a paler juxtanuclear zone and faint linear cytoplasmic streaking that may correspond to a slender Auer rod; however, a discrete Auer rod is not clearly demonstrated at this focus and resolution. No maturing granulocytes are present in this field for assessment of dysplasia. Findings are consistent with myeloblasts and, in conjunction with cytogenetic confirmation, with acute myeloid leukemia with t(8;21).

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have scant agranular cytoplasm, no hof or Auer rods, and are MPO negative.
Shows bilobed nuclei, heavy granulation, and multiple Auer rods in bundles rather than a single long slender rod.
Blasts often have cup-like nuclear invaginations and lack the long single Auer rod and salmon-colored granules typical of t(8;21).

62850.recognize_zh: CD20 染色下整片細胞幾乎都是藍色陰性，只有約 4–5 個散在的小圓細胞呈深棕色陽性，是殘存的正常 B 細胞；骨髓瘤漿細胞通常 CD20 陰性，因此這種「背景幾乎全陰」的樣式符合漿細胞腫瘤。
features: IHC for CD20 on a densely cellular marrow core
Only rare (about 4–5) scattered small round cells with strong membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining
Positive cells are small and dispersed, not forming aggregates or nodules
Vast majority of cells, including the infiltrating population, are CD20 negative
Clean background without nonspecific staining
62850.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 on the bone marrow trephine shows only rare, scattered small CD20-positive cells consistent with residual normal B lymphocytes. The densely cellular infiltrate is CD20 negative, and no B-cell aggregates or sheets are identified. Lack of CD20 expression by the infiltrating cells argues against a B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, and findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma in conjunction with CD138 and light chain studies.

ddx.vs: LPL contains a CD20-positive small B-cell component admixed with plasma cells, whereas here CD20-positive cells are only rare and scattered.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL shows CD20-positive B-cell nodules or interstitial infiltrates alongside the plasma cells, which are absent here.

ddx.dx: CD20-positive plasma cell myeloma (often with t(11;14))
ddx.vs: A minority of myelomas express CD20 on the plasma cells themselves, which would give diffuse staining of the infiltrate rather than rare scattered cells.

62786.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片紅血球密集重疊、幾乎沒有空隙，反映紅血球增多；骨髓抹片與切片細胞量符合年齡、紅系與巨核細胞形態正常，沒有真性紅血球增多症常見的三系增生與多形性巨核細胞，支持先天性（Chuvash）紅血球增多症。
features: Peripheral blood with tightly packed, overlapping red cells (increased RBC density) and few platelets (A)
Occasional neutrophil and platelet clumps without leukoerythroblastic features (A)
Aspirate particle of normal cellularity at low power (B)
Aspirate with maturing erythroid precursors, mature lymphocytes and a few neutrophils; no dysplasia (C)
Normocellular trephine with preserved fat and normal-appearing megakaryocytes without clustering (D)
62786.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows densely packed overlapping red cells, reflecting erythrocytosis, with relatively few platelets. The bone marrow aspirate is normocellular with adequate erythroid precursors showing normal maturation and no dysplastic features. The trephine biopsy is normocellular for age with preserved fat and megakaryocytes of normal size and distribution, without clustering or pleomorphism. The absence of panmyelosis and megakaryocytic atypia argues against polycythemia vera; findings are consistent with a secondary or congenital erythrocytosis, such as Chuvash polycythemia, in the appropriate molecular context.

ddx.vs: PV shows a hypercellular marrow with panmyelosis and pleomorphic, clustered megakaryocytes, low serum EPO and a JAK2 mutation, unlike this normocellular marrow.
Marrow morphology is similar; distinction relies on elevated EPO with an identified acquired cause rather than a germline VHL variant.

ddx.dx: Primary familial and congenital polycythemia (EPOR mutation)
ddx.vs: EPOR mutation causes low serum EPO, whereas VHL/Chuvash polycythemia shows normal to elevated EPO; morphology cannot separate them.
Detected by a low P50 on oxygen dissociation testing and hemoglobin analysis, not by marrow morphology.

62658.recognize_zh: 右側的大型腫瘤細胞（核大、空泡狀染色質、明顯核仁）CD20 完全陰性，左側背景小型 B 細胞則呈強膜狀陽性作為內部對照；腫瘤細胞失去 CD20 是原發性滲出性淋巴瘤（PEL）的典型免疫表現型。
features: Sheet of large neoplastic cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, CD20-negative
Strong membranous CD20 staining in adjacent small reactive B cells (internal positive control)
Tingible-body macrophages/apoptotic debris within the tumor sheet
Faint non-specific granular background staining around tumor cells
Scattered small CD20-positive cells trapped among tumor cells
62658.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry shows a sheet of large neoplastic cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and admixed apoptotic debris that lack CD20 expression. In contrast, residual small B lymphocytes on the left show strong membranous staining and serve as an internal positive control. Scattered CD20-positive small cells are trapped among the tumor cells. Findings show loss of CD20 in the neoplastic population, supporting a diagnosis of primary effusion lymphoma (extracavitary) in conjunction with HHV8 positivity.

ddx.vs: DLBCL is typically CD20 and PAX5 positive in the large cells and HHV8-negative.
Also CD20-negative with plasmacytic markers, but HHV8 (LANA-1) is negative and EBER is usually positive in immunodeficient hosts.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Arises from multicentric Castleman disease and usually retains CD20 with IgM lambda expression, and is EBV-negative.

62594.recognize_zh: CD56 免疫染色中腫瘤細胞核呈藍色、細胞膜不著色，僅少數散在的小型陽性細胞與纖細神經/梭形結構著色，表示腫瘤漿細胞 CD56 陰性。
features: Sheets of tumor cells with round to oval nuclei, negative for CD56
Rare scattered small CD56-positive cells with membranous/cytoplasmic staining (likely NK cells)
Weak staining of thin fibrillary/spindled stromal structures (nerve twigs or processes)
Clean background without significant non-specific staining
62594.describe_en: CD56 immunohistochemistry shows the neoplastic plasma cell population to be negative, with only rare scattered positive small cells and faint staining of thin stromal fibrillary structures serving as internal controls. Aberrant CD56 expression, commonly seen in plasma cell myeloma, is therefore not present. This immunoprofile is in keeping with EBV-positive plasmacytoma-like post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cells in myeloma are frequently CD56-positive, whereas the tumor here is CD56-negative, although negativity does not exclude myeloma.
NK/T-cell lymphoma shows diffuse CD56 positivity with cytoplasmic CD3 and EBER, unlike the CD56-negative tumor here.
Small-cell/neuroendocrine carcinomas are diffusely CD56-positive and keratin-positive, not CD56-negative plasmacytoid sheets.

62530.recognize_zh: 淋巴結低倍下，淡粉紅色的淋巴竇明顯擴張，內含大量細胞質豐富、淡染的大型組織球，與深藍色、密集的淋巴球／漿細胞帶交錯，形成明暗相間的圖案；這種竇擴張表現是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的特徵。
features: Markedly dilated sinuses appearing as pale pink zones at low power
Sinuses filled with large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Alternating dark bands of densely packed lymphocytes and plasma cells in intersinusoidal cords
Light-dark alternating pattern across the node
Congested vessels and hemorrhage at the periphery; no necrosis
62530.describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows marked dilatation of sinuses, which appear as pale zones filled with large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. These alternate with dark intersinusoidal cords of densely packed lymphocytes and plasma cells, producing a light-dark pattern. No necrosis or granulomas are seen. Findings are suggestive of Rosai-Dorfman disease (sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy), with confirmation by emperipolesis and S100-positive, CD1a-negative histiocytes.

ddx.vs: Reactive sinus histiocytosis shows less dramatic sinus expansion with smaller S100-negative histiocytes lacking emperipolesis.
LCH also involves sinuses but contains grooved cells with eosinophil microabscesses and necrosis, and is CD1a/langerin-positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in sinuses
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor cells are cohesive and atypical and express keratin or SOX10 rather than CD68/CD163.
ALCL shows sinusoidal pleomorphic hallmark cells that are CD30-positive, often with ALK.

62466.recognize_zh: 組合圖中 A 為肉眼可見整片深紫色的骨髓抹片；B 高倍下背景為紫紅色無結構的顆粒狀壞死物，細胞輪廓模糊，只剩核固縮（pyknosis）的深染小核與鬼影細胞，形態無法判讀，符合骨髓壞死（bone marrow necrosis）。
features: Panel A: gross slide with an intensely dark purple, thick smear visible to the naked eye
Panel B: amorphous, granular eosinophilic-to-purple proteinaceous necrotic background replacing normal hematopoietic cells
Panel B: cells with indistinct borders, pyknotic hyperchromatic nuclei, and ghost-like outlines of red cells and nucleated cells
Panel C: low-power field with poorly preserved, pale smeared material and red cells, lacking identifiable marrow elements
Panel D: blood-diluted area with an arrowed small cell showing a pyknotic/fragmented nucleus; very few viable nucleated cells
62466.describe_en: Composite figure of an iliac bone marrow aspirate. Grossly the smears are diffusely dark purple after May-Grunwald-Giemsa staining (A). Microscopically, the normal hematopoietic elements are replaced by an amorphous, granular eosinophilic-to-purple necrotic background containing ghost cells with indistinct borders and scattered pyknotic nuclei (B), with other fields showing poorly preserved material (C) and only rare degenerated cells with pyknotic or fragmented nuclei (D, arrow). Cell lineage cannot be assessed and no viable neoplastic population is identifiable on the aspirate. Findings are consistent with bone marrow necrosis; the underlying process (here a plasma cell neoplasm on biopsy) requires trephine biopsy and ancillary studies.

ddx.dx: Staining or fixation artifact (thick or poorly dried smear)
ddx.vs: Artifact affects cells uniformly but preserves identifiable nuclear and cytoplasmic detail, whereas necrosis shows pyknotic ghost cells in a granular proteinaceous background with necrosis confirmed on biopsy.
Gelatinous transformation shows a pink-purple, homogeneous mucoid ground substance with hypocellularity but no pyknotic ghost cells, and stains with Alcian blue.
Fibrosis yields a hypocellular dilute aspirate rather than necrotic debris, and the trephine shows reticulin/collagen fibrosis instead of coagulative necrosis.

ddx.dx: Diffuse marrow infiltration by acute leukemia or lymphoma with degeneration
ddx.vs: Viable blasts or lymphoma cells are identifiable in at least some fields or on biopsy, whereas here essentially no viable cells remain for morphologic or flow analysis.

62402.recognize_zh: 胃腸黏膜的固有層被密集的小淋巴球與漿細胞樣細胞大片浸潤，把腺體推開、腺體數目減少，許多細胞核被拉長扭曲成條紋狀（擠壓假影 crush artifact），並有淋巴球侵入腺上皮的傾向——這種黏膜內致密單調的淋巴漿細胞浸潤要想到 MALT 淋巴瘤。
features: Mucosal biopsy with lamina propria diffusely expanded by a dense lymphoid infiltrate that separates and reduces glands
Predominantly small lymphocytes with admixed plasma cells and occasional slightly larger centrocyte-like/monocytoid cells
Focal infiltration of glandular epithelium by lymphoid cells; well-formed lymphoepithelial lesions not clearly demonstrated in this field
Prominent crush artifact with elongated, smeared hyperchromatic nuclei
No overt sheets of large cells in this field
62402.describe_en: Low-power view of a gastrointestinal mucosal biopsy (H&E) shows a dense, diffuse lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate that expands the lamina propria, separates the glands and reduces their number. The infiltrate is composed predominantly of small lymphocytes with admixed plasma cells and focally infiltrates the glandular epithelium; well-formed lymphoepithelial lesions are not clearly seen in this field, and prominent crush artifact limits cytologic assessment. Sheets of large transformed cells are not identified. Findings are suggestive of extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of MALT type, to be confirmed with CD20, cytokeratin (for lymphoepithelial lesions), light-chain restriction and clonality studies.

ddx.dx: Chronic H. pylori gastritis with reactive lymphoid follicles
ddx.vs: Reactive gastritis has patchy, polytypic infiltrates with follicles and preserved glands rather than a dense monotonous B-cell infiltrate destroying glands.
Mantle cell lymphoma is a monotonous small-cell infiltrate without plasma cells and is cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
DLBCL shows sheets of large cells with vesicular nuclei and high Ki-67, not a small-cell lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Poorly differentiated carcinoma with crush artifact
ddx.vs: Crushed carcinoma cells are cytokeratin-positive and CD45-negative, which resolves a crushed hyperchromatic infiltrate.

62338.recognize_zh: 胸腰交界（T12）橫切面打顯影劑 T1 影像：椎體訊號不均勻，後方椎弓與棘突區有異常軟組織與強化並向椎管後側延伸，提示骨髓瘤侵犯後方結構並有硬膜外延伸。
features: Axial post-contrast T1-weighted MRI at the thoracolumbar (T12) level
Heterogeneous marrow signal within the vertebral body
Abnormal enhancing tissue in the posterior elements and spinous process region
Soft tissue at the dorsal aspect of the spinal canal suggesting epidural extension
Subcutaneous fat remains bright, so fat suppression appears incomplete on this slice, limiting assessment of enhancement
62338.describe_en: Axial post-contrast T1-weighted MRI through the T12 level shows heterogeneous marrow signal in the vertebral body and abnormal enhancing tissue involving the posterior elements and spinous process, with soft tissue extending toward the dorsal spinal canal consistent with epidural extension. The subcutaneous fat remains bright, indicating incomplete fat suppression on this slice, which limits confident assessment of enhancement. Correlation with sagittal images and assessment for cord compression are needed. The findings are consistent with myelomatous involvement of the posterior elements with epidural extension.

ddx.vs: Metastases can look identical on MRI, so serum/urine M-protein studies and biopsy are required.
Solitary plasmacytoma is a single lesion with a clonal plasma cell-negative or minimal (<10%) marrow elsewhere, whereas this patient has diffuse multilevel marrow involvement.
Epidural abscess shows peripheral rim enhancement around a fluid collection, often with discitis, rather than solid enhancing tissue contiguous with infiltrated posterior elements.

62274.recognize_zh: CD20 染色顯示一個巨大的 B 細胞結節，大小遠超下方與右側的正常濾泡，結節內染色呈斑駁不均（深棕色套層細胞夾雜較淡的區域），結節間區為 CD20 陰性的 T 區，符合 PTGC 的 B 細胞結節。
features: Giant CD20-positive B-cell nodule several times larger than adjacent CD20-positive follicles
Mottled staining within the nodule: dense strongly positive small B cells interrupted by lighter, less cellular zones
Smaller, well-formed CD20-positive follicles at the lower and right edges for size comparison
Interfollicular areas largely CD20-negative with scattered positive cells
Nodule borders are irregular and ill-defined
62274.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry highlights a markedly enlarged B-cell nodule composed of densely packed CD20-positive small B cells with an irregular, mottled internal pattern of lighter-staining zones. Adjacent follicles are normal in size, providing an internal comparison, and the interfollicular regions are predominantly CD20-negative. The findings indicate an expanded B-cell nodule without effacement of the surrounding nodal compartments. Findings are consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers in the appropriate H&E and IgD context.

ddx.vs: NLPHL also forms large CD20-rich nodules, so the discriminator is the presence of large CD20+/OCT2+ LP cells with PD-1+ T-cell rosettes, which should be sought at high power.
Follicular lymphoma shows numerous back-to-back CD20+ follicles of similar size that co-express CD10 and BCL2, rather than a solitary giant nodule among normal-sized follicles.
Reactive follicles are enlarged but retain a sharply demarcated germinal center with an intact mantle, lacking the mottled mantle-cell infiltration of a PTGC nodule.

62210.recognize_zh: 這是全血球計數報告（panel D）：白血球 179.8×10³/µL、淋巴球絕對值 126.4×10³/µL 明顯升高，合併貧血（Hb 10.1 g/dL、MCV 102.3 fL）與血小板減少（115×10³/µL），支持 CLL 的臨床表現。
features: WBC 179.80 x10^3/uL with lymphocytes 70.3% and absolute lymphocyte count 126.4 x10^3/uL (marked absolute lymphocytosis)
Neutrophil and mixed-cell counts reported as 0.0, an analyzer artifact likely related to extreme lymphocytosis (differential does not total 100%)
Anemia: RBC 3.03 x10^6/uL, Hgb 10.1 g/dL, Hct 31.0%, with macrocytosis (MCV 102.3 fL) and increased RDW (19.0%)
Thrombocytopenia: platelets 115 x10^3/uL
WBC histogram with a dominant small-cell lymphocyte peak
62210.describe_en: This figure is an automated complete blood count report rather than a morphologic image. It shows marked leukocytosis (WBC 179.8 x10^3/uL) with absolute lymphocytosis (126.4 x10^3/uL), macrocytic anemia (Hgb 10.1 g/dL, MCV 102.3 fL, RDW-CV 19.0%), and thrombocytopenia (115 x10^3/uL). The neutrophil and mixed-cell values of zero with a differential that does not sum to 100% indicate an automated differential failure in the setting of extreme lymphocytosis and require a manual smear review. In conjunction with the smear and a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype, these results are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with cytopenias (anemia and thrombocytopenia, relevant to Rai/Binet staging).

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytosis rarely exceeds 30-50 x10^3/uL and is polyclonal without cytopenias, unlike the extreme lymphocytosis here.
T-PLL can produce similarly extreme lymphocyte counts but shows a T-cell phenotype (CD3/CD7+, TCL1+) on flow cytometry rather than CD19/CD5/CD23 co-expression.

62082.recognize_zh: HPLC 報告顯示 HbF 高達 95.0%、HbA0 僅 0.3%（幾乎沒有成人血紅素），HbA2 3.9%，沒有其他變異峰，這種「HbA 缺如、HbF 為主」的圖形符合 β0 型重度地中海貧血（未輸血狀態）。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC report (non-morphologic)
HbF markedly elevated at 95.0% (retention time 1.20 min)
HbA0 essentially absent at 0.3% (2.49 min)
No abnormal variant peak; early peaks before 1 min represent minor/unknown fractions
62082.describe_en: This is a cation-exchange high-performance liquid chromatography report rather than a morphologic image. The chromatogram is dominated by a HbF peak of 95.0%, with HbA0 virtually absent at 0.3% and HbA2 at 3.9%, and no abnormal variant hemoglobin peak. The near-complete absence of HbA with predominant HbF indicates absent beta-globin chain production, consistent with homozygous or compound heterozygous beta-zero thalassemia (beta-thalassemia major), provided the sample was obtained before transfusion. Molecular HBB analysis and parental studies are recommended to define the alleles.

ddx.dx: Hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin (homozygous deletional HPFH)
ddx.vs: Homozygous HPFH also has ~100% HbF but with normal-to-mild microcytosis, no significant anemia or hemolysis, and low or absent HbA2.
Newborns have predominant HbF but still show detectable HbA (typically 10-30%) and low HbA2.
Would show a large HbE fraction eluting in the A2 window (typically 40-60%), not an A2 of only 3.9%.
Recent transfusion introduces donor HbA and lowers the apparent HbF, so a pre-transfusion sample is required for interpretation.

62018.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD34 免疫染色中，只有少數散在的單顆陽性細胞與血管內皮著色，沒有陽性母細胞成群或成片；表示母細胞未增加（<5%），符合 MDS-RS 而非高風險 MDS 或急性白血病。
features: Hypercellular marrow with numerous negative hematopoietic cells between fat spaces
Only rare scattered single CD34-positive mononuclear cells
No clusters or aggregates of CD34-positive blasts
Positive internal control staining of endothelial cells lining small vessels/sinusoids
Faint granular staining in a megakaryocyte-like cell
62018.describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemical stain of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a cellular marrow with only rare scattered single CD34-positive cells, estimated at well below 5% of cellularity in this field. There are no clusters or sheets of CD34-positive blasts. Endothelial cells of small vessels are positive, serving as an internal control. The findings indicate no increase in blasts, supporting a lower-risk myelodysplastic neoplasm such as MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: MDS-EB shows increased CD34+ blasts (5-19% in marrow), often in clusters or abnormal localization, unlike the rare single cells here.
AML shows sheets of CD34+ blasts (≥20%), not seen in this field.
CD34 alone cannot separate them; dysplasia, ring sideroblasts, and cytogenetic/SF3B1 findings are required.

61954.recognize_zh: 中倍下左側及中央是成片、細胞質較淡的大型細胞，與右側深染密集的小淋巴球殘存區形成明顯對比，顯示大細胞以黏著性片狀方式取代淋巴結結構，符合ALCL的浸潤型態。
features: Sheets of intermediate-to-large cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm occupying most of the field
Sharp contrast with a residual dark-staining cluster of small lymphocytes on the right
Cohesive growth pattern with thin fibrovascular strands
Large nuclei with vesicular chromatin, though hallmark features are not resolvable at this power
61954.describe_en: Medium-power H&E section of lymph node shows cohesive sheets of intermediate-to-large cells with pale cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei, separated by delicate fibrovascular strands and replacing much of the normal architecture. A residual aggregate of small, dark lymphocytes is present at the right. The cohesive sheet-like growth of large pale cells is compatible with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, confirmed by strong uniform CD30 and T-cell/cytotoxic markers.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive nests that are keratin-positive and CD45/CD30-negative, whereas ALCL cells are CD30+ and keratin-negative (EMA may be positive in both).
DLBCL cells are CD20+/PAX5+ and lack uniform strong CD30 with hallmark horseshoe nuclei.
cHL has scattered HRS cells in a mixed inflammatory background rather than cohesive sheets, and is CD15+ with weak PAX5.

61890.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片呈高度細胞密集，被成片偏心核、嗜鹼性胞質的漿細胞取代，核染色免疫標記大量陽性；FDG PET 最大投影與 PET/CT 顯示下肢及足部（箭頭）多處代謝活性骨病灶，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤（plasma cell myeloma）累及足骨。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow core with near-effacement of fat by a monotonous infiltrate
Sheets of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clock-face chromatin and ample amphophilic cytoplasm
Nuclear immunostain positive in the large majority of infiltrating cells (antibody not labeled)
FDG PET maximum-intensity projection with multiple hypermetabolic foci in the lower limbs
Fused PET/CT of the leg highlighting an FDG-avid lesion in the foot (arrow)
61890.describe_en: Composite figure of a bone marrow biopsy and FDG PET imaging. The H&E core biopsy is markedly hypercellular, with sheets of mature-appearing plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and abundant cytoplasm replacing normal hematopoiesis. A nuclear immunohistochemical stain (antibody not specified, likely a plasma cell-associated marker) is positive in most of the infiltrating cells. Whole-body FDG PET shows multiple hypermetabolic lesions predominantly in the lower extremities, including a focal lesion in the foot confirmed on fused PET/CT. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with extensive skeletal involvement, including the bones of the foot.

ddx.vs: Solitary plasmacytoma is a single lesion with no or minimal (<10%) clonal marrow plasma cells, whereas here the marrow is diffusely replaced and PET shows multiple lesions.
LPL contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with CD20-positive B cells and MYD88 L265P, rather than sheets of pure plasma cells.
Carcinoma forms cohesive epithelial clusters with desmoplasia and is keratin positive and CD138/light-chain restriction negative, unlike these discohesive plasma cells.
Reactive plasma cells are scattered, perivascular and polytypic by kappa/lambda staining, not sheet-like and clonal.

61890.stain: H&E; IHC (nuclear marker, unlabeled); FDG PET/CT

61826.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片可見數顆巨核細胞，核呈單一圓形、未分葉（monolobated），細胞質豐富，背景為高細胞性並以紅血球前驅細胞為主，散在含鐵血黃素，提示巨核細胞發育不良。
features: Megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated (monolobated) or hypolobated nuclei and abundant cytoplasm
Megakaryocytes loosely grouped near adipocytes
Hypercellular marrow with prominent erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei
Admixed granulocytic precursors including mature neutrophils
Scattered coarse brown hemosiderin granules; adipocytes along the left edge
61826.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with prominent erythroid precursors and maturing granulocytes. Megakaryocytes are present in normal-to-increased numbers and are notably hypolobated, with several displaying single round non-lobated nuclei. Scattered hemosiderin deposits are seen, and blast aggregates are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in a myelodysplastic neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Del(5q) also features monolobated megakaryocytes but requires the 5q deletion on cytogenetics, and typically shows erythroid hypoplasia rather than prominent erythropoiesis.
Reactive megakaryocytes are predominantly multilobated with only occasional hypolobated forms.
CML dwarf megakaryocytes accompany marked granulocytic hyperplasia with myelocyte bulge and BCR::ABL1.

61762.recognize_zh: CD20 免疫染色中片狀排列、密集的中型腫瘤細胞呈強而完整的膜狀陽性（一圈棕色環繞藍色核），只有少數陰性細胞與基質夾雜；證實為 B 細胞淋巴瘤，但 CD20 無法區分被套細胞淋巴瘤，需 cyclin D1 等輔助。
features: Diffuse sheets of tumor cells with strong complete membranous CD20 staining
Monotonous medium-sized cells with round to oval nuclei outlined by the membranous stain
Scattered CD20-negative cells (stromal, endothelial, T cells or histiocytes) with blue nuclei in small pale pockets
No nodular or follicular architecture evident; effaced diffuse growth pattern
61762.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry shows a diffuse, effacing infiltrate of monotonous medium-sized cells with strong, complete membranous staining, with only scattered negative stromal and background cells. No residual follicular pattern is apparent. The stain establishes the mature B-cell lineage of the infiltrate but does not distinguish among B-cell lymphoma subtypes.
