In the stated context, the findings are consistent with blastoid mantle cell lymphoma, which requires cyclin D1 and/or SOX11 positivity, CD5 co-expression and a Ki-67 assessment.

ddx.vs: Is also diffusely CD20 positive but composed of larger cells and negative for cyclin D1 and SOX11 (CD5 only in a minority).
Blasts are often CD20 weak or negative and express TdT and CD34 rather than strong membranous CD20.
Shows a starry-sky pattern with CD10+ BCL6+ BCL2-negative cells, Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Small lymphocytic lymphoma with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Contains proliferation centers and is CD23 and LEF1 positive with weaker CD20 and cyclin D1 negative except in proliferation centers.

61698.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀 CD45 對側向散射（SSC）圖：淋巴球 gate 僅佔 4.70%，另有一群 CD45 較弱、SSC 低至中等的細胞位於淋巴球左側，這類 CD45 dim/陰性區域正是骨髓瘤漿細胞常出現的位置，但此圖本身無法確認其為漿細胞。
features: Dot plot: CD45 KO (x-axis) versus side scatter (y-axis), gated on live events
Lymphocyte gate (CD45-bright, low SSC) contains 4.70% of total events
Large granulocytic cluster with moderate CD45 and high SSC
Distinct population with dim-to-negative CD45 and low-to-intermediate SSC to the left of the lymphocytes
No plasma cell-specific markers (CD38/CD138) shown; lineage of the CD45-dim population cannot be assigned from this plot alone
61698.describe_en: Flow cytometric CD45 versus side scatter plot of live events shows a predominant granulocytic population with high side scatter and a small lymphocyte gate comprising 4.70% of total events. A separate population with dim-to-negative CD45 and low-to-intermediate side scatter lies to the left of the lymphocytes; this region contains erythroid precursors but is also where neoplastic plasma cells, which characteristically lose CD45, are found. This plot is a gating overview and does not by itself identify plasma cells; bright CD38/CD138 gating with CD19, CD56 and cytoplasmic kappa/lambda is required. The pattern is compatible with, but not diagnostic of, a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Erythroid precursors also sit in the CD45-negative/low SSC region but are CD71/CD235a-positive and CD38/CD138-negative.
Normal plasma cells are usually CD45-positive (at least partially) and CD19+/CD56- with polytypic light chains, unlike CD45-negative clonal myeloma cells.

61634.recognize_zh: 這張周邊血液抹片只看到紅血球（部分鈍鋸齒狀、少數短鏈狀疊排）、零星小血小板聚集與一個小型單核細胞，沒有明確的淋巴瘤細胞；血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤周邊血通常找不到腫瘤細胞，單憑此圖無法診斷。
features: Normochromic red cells with scattered crenated forms (echinocytes, possibly drying artifact)
Short rouleaux-like stack of red cells in the center
One small mononuclear cell with dense round nucleus and scant pale cytoplasm, most consistent with a lymphocyte
Small platelet clumps; platelets not increased
No large atypical lymphoid cells identified in this field
61634.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with scattered crenated forms, which may be artifactual, and a short rouleaux-like stack. A single small mononuclear cell with a dense round nucleus is present and is most consistent with a small lymphocyte. Platelets are present as small clumps. No circulating large atypical lymphoid cells are identified in this field. The peripheral blood is nonspecific; intravascular large B-cell lymphoma frequently lacks circulating tumor cells, and the diagnosis requires tissue (e.g., marrow or skin) biopsy.

ddx.vs: Leukemic DLBCL shows obvious large atypical lymphoid cells with basophilic cytoplasm and nucleoli in the blood, which are absent here.
True rouleaux forms long stacks throughout thin areas of the smear with increased background staining, rather than an isolated short stack.

ddx.dx: Echinocytes from uremia/liver disease versus artifact
ddx.vs: True echinocytes are uniformly distributed in all fields, whereas drying artifact is regional and near thick areas.

61570.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中有四顆比右側成熟小淋巴球大得多的母細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻、核形略不規則，細胞質少量淡藍無顆粒；和旁邊小淋巴球的濃縮染色質對比，可確認為淋巴母細胞（B-ALL）。
features: Four circulating blasts of variable size, considerably larger than the adjacent small mature lymphocyte
High N:C ratio with scant to moderate pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Round to angular/irregular nuclei, some with slight folds
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin with indistinct nucleoli
Small mature lymphocyte with condensed chromatin at right for comparison; scattered platelets
61570.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows four circulating blasts of variable size, all substantially larger than a small mature lymphocyte on the right. The blasts have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to irregular nuclei with slight folds, finely dispersed chromatin with indistinct nucleoli, and scant to moderate agranular pale blue cytoplasm. No Auer rods or granules are seen; red cells and platelets are unremarkable in this field. Findings are consistent with circulating lymphoblasts; immunophenotyping confirms B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts often have more cytoplasm, visible nucleoli, granules or Auer rods and are MPO-positive.
Hematogones are smaller, with smooth homogeneous chromatin, very scant cytoplasm and a normal maturation spectrum on flow.
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent vacuoles and a TdT-negative mature B-cell phenotype.

61506.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑明顯增粗、形狀不規則並彼此吻合連結，占去大部分髓腔（osteosclerosis）；小樑間的造血組織夾雜漩渦狀、呈束狀排列的細胞與纖維化區域，提示晚期骨髓增生性腫瘤（如真性紅血球增多症後骨髓纖維化）。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae occupying a large proportion of the marrow space
Trabeculae show lamellar bone with scattered osteocyte lacunae
Intertrabecular spaces contain cellular areas with streaming, whorled, fibrotic stroma
Dilated sinusoids and scattered adipocytes between trabeculae
Individual megakaryocyte morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification
61506.describe_en: Low-power view of the bone marrow core biopsy shows marked osteosclerosis with thickened, irregular, and anastomosing bony trabeculae occupying a large portion of the marrow space. The intertrabecular marrow contains cellular areas with a streaming, whorled stromal pattern suggestive of fibrosis, along with dilated sinusoids and scattered adipocytes. Megakaryocyte detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification, and reticulin and trichrome stains are required to grade the fibrosis. Findings are consistent with the fibrotic phase of a myeloproliferative neoplasm, such as post-polycythemic myelofibrosis in the given clinical context.

ddx.vs: Metastatic carcinoma forms cohesive epithelial nests within desmoplastic stroma that are keratin positive, unlike the hematopoietic streaming here.
Renal osteodystrophy shows osteoclastic tunneling resorption and peritrabecular fibrosis rather than marrow replacement by an MPN with atypical megakaryocytes.
Paget disease has a mosaic pattern of irregular cement lines with active osteoclasts and osteoblasts, and an otherwise normal hematopoietic marrow.
Mastocytosis can cause osteosclerosis but shows paratrabecular aggregates of spindled CD117+/tryptase+ mast cells with eosinophils.

61442.recognize_zh: 扁桃腺鱗狀上皮內可見多個圓形、界線清楚的非典型淋巴細胞巢（類 Pautrier 微膿瘍），細胞巢周圍有收縮間隙；C 圖免疫染色使上皮內與上皮下的淋巴細胞巢瀰漫陽性，提示成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤具親上皮性。
features: Panel A: low-power tonsil with diffuse lymphoid infiltrate and circled surface squamous epithelium
Panel B: squamous epithelium containing multiple well-circumscribed, rounded intraepithelial nests of atypical lymphoid cells with peripheral retraction spaces
Lymphoid cells are small to medium with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei, and similar cells diffusely infiltrate the underlying tissue
Panel C: immunostain with strong diffuse positivity in the intraepithelial nests and subepithelial infiltrate (antibody not labeled)
61442.describe_en: Composite tonsillar biopsy. At low power (A), the tonsil is diffusely infiltrated by lymphoid cells. The overlying squamous epithelium (B) contains multiple sharply circumscribed intraepithelial aggregates of atypical small to medium lymphoid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei, forming Pautrier-like microabscesses, with a similar dense infiltrate beneath the epithelium. An immunostain (C) highlights the neoplastic cells within the nests and in the subepithelial infiltrate; the antibody is not specified. The epidermotropic-like pattern is consistent with a mature T-cell lymphoma, and in this context supports adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; HTLV-1 serology and CD4/CD25/FOXP3 immunophenotyping are recommended.

ddx.vs: True Pautrier microabscesses occur in skin with cerebriform cells and no HTLV-1 infection, rather than in tonsillar mucosa.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with lymphoepithelial lesions
ddx.vs: B cells (CD20+) infiltrate and destroy glands/crypt epithelium rather than forming discrete intraepithelial T-cell nests.
May be epitheliotropic but is HTLV-1 negative and usually lacks the CD25+/FOXP3+ regulatory T-cell phenotype of ATLL.
Reactive intraepithelial lymphocytes are scattered, mixed B and T cells, without cohesive atypical nests.

61378.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的淋巴球核呈深摺疊、腦迴狀（cerebriform）的分葉外觀，細胞質稀少，下方另一顆細胞也有類似扭曲摺疊的核，符合 Sézary 細胞。
features: Small to medium lymphocytes (roughly 1-1.5 times erythrocyte diameter)
Markedly convoluted, cerebriform nuclei with deep grooves creating a lobulated, brain-like contour
Condensed, hyperchromatic chromatin; nucleoli not seen
Scant rim of pale blue cytoplasm, with faint cytoplasmic vacuolation in the lower cell
Background erythrocytes with rouleaux-like stacking in thicker area
61378.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows atypical small to medium lymphocytes with deeply convoluted, cerebriform nuclei, condensed chromatin and a scant rim of pale cytoplasm (arrow and lower cell). No blasts or granular lymphocytes are present in the field. In the appropriate clinical setting of erythroderma and with a CD3+/CD4+ phenotype, often with loss of CD7 and/or CD26, these findings are consistent with Sézary cells of Sézary syndrome.

ddx.vs: ATLL cells are flower cells with polylobated, petal-like nuclei and are HTLV-1 positive, typically CD25 bright, rather than finely grooved cerebriform nuclei.
T-PLL cells have a single prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, and are associated with TCL1A rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphocytes with nuclear folding (benign erythroderma, drug reaction)
ddx.vs: Small numbers of cerebriform cells occur in reactive states, so clonality and an aberrant CD4+ phenotype with CD7/CD26 loss are needed for diagnosis.
CLL cells have round nuclei with coarse block-like chromatin and B-cell phenotype (CD5+/CD23+) without nuclear convolutions.

61314.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個大型巨核細胞，細胞質豐富、邊緣充滿粉紫色顆粒，核重疊而輪廓不清，細胞邊緣未見明顯血小板成串脫落；此類顆粒型巨核細胞可見於 ITP，但並非特異表現。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant cytoplasm filled with fine pink-purple granules
Dense, overlapping nuclear lobes with indistinct outline
Granular cytoplasmic periphery without evident platelet budding
Surrounding small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors
Thick smear area with poorly spread red cells and a small platelet clump
61314.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular cytoplasm and dense, overlapping nuclear lobes whose outlines are partly obscured. No definite platelet budding is seen at the cytoplasmic margin. The surrounding field contains small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors in a thick area with poorly spread red cells. Megakaryocytes with reduced platelet shedding may be seen in immune thrombocytopenia, but this morphology is nonspecific and must be interpreted with clinical and peripheral blood findings.

ddx.vs: MDS megakaryocytes are typically small, hypolobated, or have separated nuclei, with dysplasia in other lineages.
Normal megakaryocytes look similar, and ITP cannot be diagnosed from megakaryocyte morphology without peripheral thrombocytopenia and exclusion of other causes.
Tumor clusters are cohesive groups of multiple cells with separate nuclei and lack the fine azurophilic cytoplasmic granules of megakaryocytes.

61250.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中箭頭所指處有一團比周圍造血細胞大、染色較深而緊密聚集的細胞團，在細胞豐富的背景中形成醒目的「團塊」，提示轉移性癌侵犯骨髓。
features: Very low-power field of a highly cellular aspirate spread
Arrow marks a cohesive aggregate of larger, darker cells distinct from the dispersed hematopoietic cells
Additional dense dark zones along the thick part of the smear that cannot be resolved at this power
Scattered fat vacuoles; no cytologic detail assessable
61250.describe_en: Low-power view of a Wright-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular spread with scattered fat vacuoles. An aggregate of larger, darker-staining cells (arrow) stands out from the dispersed hematopoietic cells, suggesting a cohesive cell cluster. Nuclear and cytoplasmic detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification, and dense thick areas limit interpretation. The finding is suggestive of metastatic tumor clusters but requires high-power examination and immunohistochemical confirmation on the trephine biopsy.

ddx.vs: At high power a megakaryocyte is a single cell with a lobulated nucleus rather than a group of separate cohesive nuclei.

ddx.dx: Thick smear artifact or clumped particle
ddx.vs: Thick areas contain overlapping normal hematopoietic cells with maturation when examined at the thin edge, lacking a discrete population of large atypical cells.
Histiocytic aggregates show epithelioid cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and bland oval nuclei, often with admixed lymphocytes.

61186.recognize_zh: D 圖普魯士藍染色中呈索狀排列的實質細胞充滿粗大藍色鐵顆粒，C 圖骨髓鐵染色散佈藍色鐵沉積，B 圖免疫染色幾乎陰性僅見棕色含鐵血黃素；在 ABO 不相容移植後，指向紅血球生成缺乏而鐵未被利用、造成鐵過載。
features: Panel A: H&E marrow with cells having round, hyperchromatic, often eccentric nuclei and eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm between fat spaces; lineage not certain at this resolution
Panel B: immunohistochemical stain (marker not labeled) essentially negative in the hematopoietic cells, with scattered golden-brown hemosiderin granules
Panel C: low-power iron stain of marrow with numerous scattered blue-staining iron deposits
Panel D: Prussian blue stain of a parenchymal organ with cord-like plates of cells (suggestive of liver) packed with coarse granular blue iron
Image resolution is low, limiting cytologic detail
61186.describe_en: The composite shows a bone marrow biopsy with cells bearing round hyperchromatic, often eccentric nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm among fat spaces (A), and an immunostain that is essentially negative in the hematopoietic cells apart from brown hemosiderin granules (B). An iron stain of the marrow demonstrates increased scattered stainable iron (C), and a Prussian blue stain of a parenchymal organ with plate-like architecture, suggestive of liver, shows heavy granular iron deposition (D). Marker identities are not labeled, and resolution limits interpretation. In the setting of an ABO-incompatible transplant, the findings suggest failed erythroid utilization of iron (such as post-transplant pure red cell aplasia) with resulting iron overload.

ddx.vs: Hemochromatosis deposits iron predominantly in periportal hepatocytes with relatively little marrow macrophage iron, and is explained by HFE genotype rather than transfusion or failed erythropoiesis.
Ring sideroblasts show iron granules encircling erythroblast nuclei on aspirate iron stain, whereas this picture shows storage iron with absent erythroid utilization.
Anemia of inflammation also has increased marrow storage iron but erythropoiesis is preserved and hepatic parenchymal iron overload is not prominent.

61186.stain: H&E; IHC (marker not labeled); Prussian blue

61122.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD20 染色下，陽性 B 細胞主要聚成散在的小結節（殘存濾泡或 B 細胞聚集），結節之間只有稀疏陽性細胞，浸潤的大部分區域為陰性；與 CD3 對照可見 T 細胞佔多數，而漿細胞樣腫瘤成分不表現 CD20。
features: Scanning magnification of a skin biopsy with a dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate
CD20-positive B cells concentrated in multiple small, discrete nodular aggregates (follicle-like)
Sparse, scattered CD20-positive cells in the internodular infiltrate
Large portions of the infiltrate are CD20 negative (T cells and plasmacytic cells)
Epidermis and deep fibrous tissue negative; cytology not assessable at this power
61122.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry on a skin biopsy, viewed at scanning magnification, highlights B cells mainly within multiple small nodular, follicle-like aggregates distributed through the dermis, with only scattered positive cells in the intervening infiltrate. Much of the infiltrate is CD20 negative, corresponding to abundant background T cells and a plasmacytic component. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. Because the neoplastic cells of cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma are frequently plasmacytic and CD20 negative, the relatively limited B-cell staining does not exclude lymphoma, and clonality should be assessed with kappa/lambda ISH.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia also shows B-cell follicles within a T-cell rich infiltrate but has polytypic plasma cells on kappa/lambda ISH.
PCFCL shows larger confluent CD20+ nodules or diffuse sheets of BCL6+ centrocytes/centroblasts rather than small aggregates with a CD20-negative plasmacytic neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD4+ small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: This T-cell process is dominated by PD1+ CD4+ T cells with admixed B cells but lacks light-chain-restricted plasma cells.

61058.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片滿是染色質呈細緻網狀（sieve-like）的巨大紅血球前驅細胞（megaloblasts），並有核呈大馬蹄形的巨大帶狀核細胞（giant band cells），這兩者並存就是巨母細胞性造血的特徵。
features: Large erythroid precursors (megaloblasts) with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and open, finely stippled chromatin
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony in maturing erythroid cells
Giant band and metamyelocyte forms with large horseshoe-shaped nuclei and abundant granular cytoplasm
Erythroid hyperplasia in a highly cellular aspirate
Scattered small, more mature orthochromatic normoblasts and lymphocytes
61058.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with erythroid hyperplasia. Erythroid precursors are enlarged with open, finely stippled chromatin that is immature relative to the cytoplasm, consistent with megaloblastic change. Granulocytic precursors include giant metamyelocytes and giant band forms with large horseshoe-shaped nuclei. No increase in blasts is evident in this field. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic hematopoiesis, as seen in vitamin B12 or folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of pronormoblasts without orderly maturation or giant granulocytic forms and does not correct with vitamin replacement.
MDS megaloblastoid erythroids are usually accompanied by hypogranular/hypolobated neutrophils and dysplastic megakaryocytes, with normal B12/folate.
Morphology is indistinguishable; medication history and normal vitamin levels separate them.

60866.recognize_zh: Lambda 原位雜交在同一深層真皮區域只見零星散在的陽性漿細胞，數量遠少於 kappa ISH 的成群陽性細胞，兩者對照呈 kappa 限制性，支持單株性邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Only rare, scattered cells with dark blue cytoplasmic lambda mRNA signal
Positive cells are single and do not form clusters
Most lymphoid cells in the deep dermis near fat are signal negative
Marked contrast with the abundant kappa-positive cells in the same area (kappa:lambda skewed)
60866.describe_en: Lambda light-chain mRNA in situ hybridization on the same area of deep dermis shows only rare scattered positive plasmacytic cells, with the majority of lymphoid cells signal negative. Compared with the numerous clustered kappa-positive cells on the paired stain, the plasmacytic population shows a markedly elevated kappa:lambda ratio. Findings indicate kappa light-chain restriction and support primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates contain lambda-positive cells in roughly one-third to one-half the number of kappa cells, not the rare cells seen here.
Scattered strongly positive internal-control cells confirm the stain worked, so the paucity of lambda cells reflects true restriction.
Plasmacytoma is also light-chain restricted but consists of sheets of plasma cells without the marginal zone B-cell and reactive follicle background.

60802.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆小淋巴細胞核形不規則、呈三角形或有切迹，胞質中等量且偏嗜鹼性，與典型 CLL 圓核、粗塊狀染色質的樣貌不同；右下為被壓碎的細胞（smudge cell）。這類非典型型態常見於 12 號染色體三體的 CLL。
features: Small to medium lymphocyte with irregular, angulated/indented nucleus
Moderately condensed chromatin, less coarsely clumped than typical CLL cells
Moderate amount of pale-to-medium blue cytoplasm
Crushed/smudged cell with disrupted outline (lower right)
Normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis; scattered platelets
60802.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small to medium-sized lymphoid cell with an irregular, angulated nuclear contour, moderately condensed chromatin and a moderate rim of blue cytoplasm. A smudged, disrupted cell is present in the lower right. Red cells are unremarkable. In a patient with a CLL immunophenotype, such atypical (cleaved, more cytoplasmic) lymphocytes are suggestive of CLL with atypical morphology, a pattern associated with trisomy 12.

ddx.vs: Cells may be cleaved and similar, but are CD5+/CD23-negative with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression and t(11;14).
Shows smaller cells with deep narrow clefts (buttock cells) and scant cytoplasm, and is CD10+/CD5-negative.
Lymphocytes have polar villous projections and are typically CD5-/CD23-negative.
Reactive forms are larger with abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells and a polyclonal B-cell population on flow.

60610.recognize_zh: 每格中並列兩種小顆粒：藍色箭頭為紫紅色、有顆粒的真正血小板，紅色箭頭為與紅血球同色、無顆粒、大小相近的極小紅血球或碎片（microcytes/fragments），容易被自動計數器誤算為血小板。
features: Very small red cell fragments and microcytes (red arrows) roughly platelet-sized, staining the same pink-tan color as red cells without granules
Some small red cells are crenated or have spiky outlines; others are ovoid or teardrop-shaped
True platelets (blue arrows) are purple with central azurophilic granules and a slightly fuzzy border
Background: marked poikilocytosis with echinocytes, elliptocytes/ovalocytes and target-like cells
No nucleated red cells in these fields
60610.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with ovalocytes, elliptocytes and crenated cells. Numerous extremely small red cells and red cell fragments are present that approach the size of platelets but lack granules and stain the color of hemoglobin, in contrast to true platelets, which are purple and granular. Such microcytes and fragments can be counted as platelets by impedance analyzers, spuriously elevating the platelet count, and a smear review or optical/fluorescent platelet count is recommended. Findings are consistent with severe microcytosis and fragmentation in beta-thalassemia causing pseudothrombocytosis.

ddx.vs: MAHA fragments are helmet and triangular cells with thrombocytopenia, whereas here the tiny cells accompany thalassemic poikilocytosis.
Platelets of any size retain purple granules and a pale hyalomere, unlike the homogeneous hemoglobinized microcytes.
Microspherocytes are round, dense and lack central pallor, whereas many small cells here are irregular or crenated fragments.
Cryoprecipitates are pale blue amorphous deposits and debris lacks the red cell color and shape.

60674.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球母細胞（黃箭頭）與早期顆粒球前驅細胞（紅箭頭）的細胞質內出現多個小而清楚的空泡，並伴隨紅系前驅細胞增加，這種同時累及紅系與顆粒球系的空泡化是銅缺乏的重要線索，容易被誤認為 MDS。
features: Cellular aspirate with increased erythroid precursors, many with round nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Multiple small, discrete, punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles in early erythroid precursors (yellow arrows)
Similar cytoplasmic vacuolation in an early myeloid precursor (promyelocyte/myelocyte; red arrow)
Occasional binucleated erythroid cell and a mitotic figure; mild megaloblastoid nuclear features
No increase in blasts or ring-forming abnormal granulation evident in this field
60674.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate is cellular with prominent erythroid precursors and maturing granulocytes. Numerous early erythroid and myeloid precursors contain multiple small, sharply defined cytoplasmic vacuoles, with occasional binucleate erythroid forms and a mitotic figure. Blasts are not increased in this field. In a patient after gastric bypass, precursor vacuolation of both lineages suggests copper deficiency; an iron stain for ring sideroblasts and serum copper, ceruloplasmin, zinc and iron studies are recommended. Findings are consistent with nutritional cytopenia due to concurrent copper and iron deficiency mimicking myelodysplastic syndrome.

ddx.vs: MDS shows clonal dysplasia (pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, micromegakaryocytes, ring sideroblasts with SF3B1) that persists, whereas copper-related vacuolation resolves with repletion.
Alcohol produces identical precursor vacuoles and ring sideroblasts, so drinking history and copper levels are needed to separate them.
These drugs also cause erythroid vacuolation, and the discriminator is medication history rather than morphology.
VEXAS shows vacuoles largely restricted to myeloid and erythroid precursors in older men with inflammatory symptoms and UBA1 somatic mutations.

60738.recognize_zh: 周邊血中血小板少且出現與紅血球大小相近的巨大血小板（C 箭頭），嗜中性球細胞質內有淡藍色、類似 Döhle 小體的包涵體 (A 虛線箭頭)，電子顯微鏡 (B) 見無膜包覆的細絲狀聚集區，組合符合 MYH9 相關疾病。
features: Panel A: thrombocytopenic smear; neutrophils (dashed arrow) with a faint pale-blue cytoplasmic inclusion resembling a Döhle body (subtle at this resolution)
Panel A: small platelet at upper right, few platelets overall
Panel B (electron microscopy): neutrophil cytoplasm with a non-membrane-bound area of fine filamentous, ribosome-poor material (arrow)
Panel C: giant platelet approaching the size of a red cell (arrow) next to a lymphocyte and neutrophils
Panel D: pale-blue structure between red cells (arrow), likely a pale giant platelet or detached inclusion
Red cells normocytic, normochromic
60738.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows thrombocytopenia with giant platelets, some approaching the size of red cells, and neutrophils containing faint pale-blue, Döhle-like cytoplasmic inclusions. Electron microscopy of a neutrophil demonstrates a non-membrane-bound aggregate of fine filaments corresponding to the light microscopic inclusion. Findings are consistent with an MYH9-related disorder (congenital macrothrombocytopenia with neutrophil inclusions); confirmation by non-muscle myosin IIA immunofluorescence and MYH9 genetic testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: ITP may have large platelets but lacks neutrophil inclusions and giant platelets as large as red cells, and responds to immunosuppression.
Bernard-Soulier shows giant platelets without neutrophil inclusions and absent ristocetin-induced agglutination due to GPIb-IX-V deficiency.
Gray platelets are large, pale and agranular due to alpha-granule deficiency, without Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions.
True Döhle bodies accompany toxic granulation in sepsis and are not associated with lifelong giant platelets or MYH9 aggregates.

60546.recognize_zh: 視野中有三顆中型淋巴細胞，核略不規則、染色質粗塊狀，細胞質量中等淡藍，部分可見細小紫紅色顆粒，形態似大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）；上方另有一顆嗜中性球可作大小對照。
features: Three medium-sized lymphocytes, slightly smaller than the adjacent neutrophil
Round to mildly irregular or indented nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin; no nucleoli
Moderate pale-blue cytoplasm with sparse fine azurophilic granules in some cells
Segmented neutrophil at the top for size comparison
Normochromic red cells with some slit-like central pallor; adequate platelets
60546.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells, adequate platelets, and a segmented neutrophil. Three medium-sized lymphocytes are present, with round to mildly irregular nuclei, coarse mature chromatin, no nucleoli, and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm containing sparse fine azurophilic granules. No blasts or overtly atypical cells are seen. The morphology is that of large granular lymphocytes, and with a longstanding lymphocytosis and an NK-cell immunophenotype, findings are consistent with chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; T-LGL expresses surface CD3 with clonal TCR rearrangement and often STAT3 mutation, whereas CLPD-NK is sCD3-negative, CD16/CD56-positive with restricted or absent KIR expression.
Reactive expansions are transient and polyclonal with a normal KIR repertoire and a clear trigger such as viral infection.
ANKL cells are larger, with open chromatin and nucleoli, EBV-positive, and the patient is acutely ill.

60482.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片免疫染色中，大片區域幾乎所有造血間隙細胞皆呈棕色陽性，且延伸至脂肪細胞之間，呈瀰漫性淋巴樣浸潤（染色標記未標明，可能為 B 細胞標記）。
features: Low-power bone marrow core with extensive diffuse brown immunoreactivity
Positive infiltrate fills intertrabecular spaces as solid sheets and extends interstitially between adipocytes
No discrete nodules or paratrabecular pattern; infiltrate is diffuse
Few negative areas limited to fat and fibrous/crushed tissue
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
60482.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy immunostain shows an extensive diffuse and interstitial infiltrate with strong positivity replacing much of the marrow space and extending between adipocytes. No nodular or paratrabecular architecture is evident. The specific antibody is not stated and cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the clinical context, findings are consistent with diffuse marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia, highlighted by a lymphoid (likely B-cell) marker.

ddx.vs: SMZL typically shows nodular and intrasinusoidal marrow involvement and lacks CD25, CD103, and annexin A1.
CLL shows CD5/CD23 co-expression and nodular-interstitial infiltrates of small round lymphocytes with proliferation centers, without hairy cell markers.
HCL marrows can look hypocellular on H&E, but the immunostain reveals a subtle diffuse interstitial infiltrate that is absent in aplastic anemia.

60354.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆比旁邊嗜中性球大的非典型單核細胞，核輪廓不規則、染色質中度細緻，細胞質一圈灰藍色且無顆粒；在 BPDCN 病人中這種罕見循環腫瘤細胞形態並不特異，需流式確認 CD4/CD56/CD123。
features: Single circulating atypical mononuclear cell, larger than the adjacent neutrophil
Moderately high N:C ratio with a rim of pale blue-gray agranular cytoplasm
Irregular, indented nuclear contour with moderately fine chromatin; nucleoli not distinct
Adjacent mature segmented neutrophil and scattered platelets for size and stain comparison
Red cells show rouleaux-like stacking in this field (may reflect a thick area of the smear)
60354.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a rare circulating atypical mononuclear cell that is larger than a mature neutrophil, with a moderately high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, an irregular indented nuclear contour, moderately fine chromatin and a rim of pale blue-gray agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are identified. A mature segmented neutrophil and scattered platelets are present, and the red cells show rouleaux-like stacking that may be related to smear thickness. The atypical cell is morphologically nonspecific; in a patient with known blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, it likely represents low-level circulating disease, which should be confirmed by flow cytometry for CD4, CD56 and CD123.

ddx.vs: Monocytes have abundant gray cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles and more condensed, lacy folded chromatin rather than a high N:C blastoid appearance.
Monocytic blasts have more abundant cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and are lysozyme/CD14-positive by flow, lacking the CD123-bright/CD303+ pDC phenotype.

ddx.dx: Sézary or other atypical lymphoid cell
ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform, deeply grooved nuclei with condensed chromatin and a CD3+CD4+CD7- T-cell phenotype.

60162.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度極高，紅血球系與顆粒球系前驅細胞密集增生，並散在許多大小懸殊、核分葉過多的巨核細胞，部分鬆散成群；三系增生而無纖維化，符合真性紅血球增多症增生期。
features: Hypercellular marrow with markedly reduced fat
Panmyelosis with abundant erythroid precursors (round dark nuclei) and granulocytic precursors
Numerous megakaryocytes of widely varying size, many large with hyperlobated nuclei, occasionally in loose clusters
No prominent hyperchromatic cloud-like megakaryocyte nuclei
No fibrosis or sinusoidal streaming evident
60162.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage proliferation. Megakaryocytes are markedly increased and pleomorphic, including large forms with hyperlobated nuclei arranged singly and in loose clusters. Erythroid and granulocytic precursors are expanded with preserved maturation. There is no evident fibrosis or excess blasts in this field. Findings are consistent with polycythemia vera, proliferative (polycythemic) phase.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are predominantly giant with staghorn nuclei in a normocellular marrow without erythroid and granulocytic proliferation.
Megakaryocytes form tight clusters with bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei and aberrant maturation, and erythropoiesis is reduced.
Megakaryocytes are increased but show normal morphology and distribution without panmyelosis or JAK2 mutation.

60098.recognize_zh: 兩個巨核細胞的細胞質豐富但核型異常：左圖為單一圓形不分葉的核，右圖為兩個分離的圓形核，缺乏正常巨核細胞的多葉相連核；在 GATA2 缺乏症（Emberger syndrome）的骨髓抹片中，這類分離核與單圓核是典型的巨核細胞發育不良（dysmegakaryopoiesis）。
features: Megakaryocytes with abundant granular pale-violet cytoplasm but relatively small nuclear mass
Left panel: single round non-lobated (monolobated) nucleus eccentrically placed
Right panel: two widely separated round nuclei (separated nuclear lobes)
Nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; no normal hyperlobated contiguous nucleus
Background of red cells and small mature lymphocytes; no blasts in these fields
60098.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows megakaryocytes with dysplastic nuclear features. One megakaryocyte has abundant granular cytoplasm with a single round, non-lobated eccentric nucleus, and another contains two widely separated round nuclei rather than a contiguous multilobated nucleus. These hypolobated and multinucleated forms with separated nuclear lobes represent megakaryocytic dysplasia. In a patient with GATA2 deficiency (Emberger syndrome), findings are suggestive of evolution toward a myelodysplastic neoplasm and should be correlated with cellularity, blast count, and cytogenetics (e.g. monosomy 7).

ddx.vs: Characteristically shows small-to-normal-sized monolobated or bilobed megakaryocytes too, but in a normo- to hypercellular marrow with macrocytic anemia and thrombocytosis; confirmed by del(5q) karyotype.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased and may be immature but retain contiguous lobulated nuclei without widely separated round nuclear lobes.

ddx.dx: Micromegakaryocytes of CML or other MDS
ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small (near myelocyte size) with scant cytoplasm, whereas these cells retain abundant cytoplasm with abnormal nuclear lobation.
Megaloblastic megakaryocytes may show hypersegmented, separated lobes but are accompanied by megaloblastic erythroid and giant granulocytic precursors and resolve with B12/folate.

60034.recognize_zh: 紅色母細胞群位於 CD45 弱陽、低 SSC 區，表現 CD34、CD117、CD13 與弱陽性 CD33，細胞內 MPO 部分陽性，而 CD19、CD7、CD3、CD15 與胞內 CD79a 皆為陰性，判讀為髓系母細胞增加。
features: Red-gated blasts with dim CD45 and low side scatter, clearly separate from bright CD45 lymphocytes
CD34 positive and CD117 positive (moderate, uniform)
CD13 positive with dim CD33
Intracellular MPO partially positive (a subset of blasts in the MPO-positive quadrant)
Negative for CD19, CD7, surface CD3, CD15, and intracellular CD79a
60034.describe_en: Flow cytometric plots show a red-gated blast population with dim CD45 and low side scatter. The blasts express CD34, CD117, CD13, and dim CD33, with partial intracellular myeloperoxidase positivity. They lack CD19, CD7, CD3, CD15, and intracellular CD79a, arguing against B- or T-lineage involvement and against significant maturation. The immunophenotype is that of myeloid blasts; the diagnosis of acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes depends on blast percentage together with morphologic dysplasia, cytogenetics, or prior MDS history rather than flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: MPAL requires lineage-defining B (strong CD19 plus cCD79a/CD10/CD22) or T (cytoplasmic CD3) markers, which are absent here.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 lacks MPO by cytochemistry and flow (<3%), whereas this population shows partial MPO positivity.
AUL lacks MPO and lineage-specific markers, while these blasts express MPO along with CD13 and CD117.

ddx.dx: Regenerating marrow with increased normal CD34-positive progenitors
ddx.vs: Normal progenitors show an orderly maturation continuum and heterogeneous CD13/CD33/CD34 patterns rather than a discrete, expanded blast cluster.

29314.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中的原始細胞一端拉出含胞質的尾狀突起（uropod，箭頭），整體形如手持鏡子，即 hand-mirror cell；但光憑此形態無法判定系列，須靠流式細胞分析。
features: Blasts about 2 times the diameter of a red cell with high N:C ratio
Asymmetric cell shape with a single cytoplasmic tail-like projection (uropod), giving a hand-mirror configuration (arrows)
Round to slightly indented nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Scant pale basophilic cytoplasm concentrated in the uropod, with a small zone of fine granularity near its base (arrowheads) and a few small vacuoles
Background red cells without notable abnormality
29314.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows blasts with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant pale basophilic cytoplasm. Many blasts are polarized, with the cytoplasm drawn into a single tail-like uropod, producing the characteristic hand-mirror morphology; a small area of fine granularity is seen at the base of the uropod, and scattered cytoplasmic vacuoles are present. No definite Auer rods are identified. Hand-mirror cells are a nonspecific morphologic variant seen in both acute myeloid and acute lymphoblastic leukemia, so lineage assignment requires flow cytometry and cytochemistry.

ddx.dx: B- or T-lymphoblastic leukemia with hand-mirror cells
ddx.vs: Hand-mirror morphology does not separate ALL from AML; MPO negativity and lymphoid antigen expression on flow cytometry define lymphoblastic lineage.
Monocytic cells have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, folded nuclei and nonspecific esterase positivity, rather than scant cytoplasm confined to a uropod.
Reactive lymphocytes have mature clumped chromatin and cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells, whereas these cells have fine blast chromatin.

10754.recognize_zh: 左圖一個遠大於旁邊嗜中性球的巨大原紅血球（giant pronormoblast），核圓、染色質細緻均勻呈毛玻璃樣，胞質一圈深藍嗜鹼性；右圖為較小的類似早期紅血球母細胞，背景幾乎沒有其他紅系前驅細胞，符合小病毒 B19 感染的紅系表現。
features: Giant pronormoblast several times the diameter of an adjacent neutrophil
Round nucleus with finely granular, homogeneous glassy chromatin occupying most of the cell
Nucleoli not clearly discernible (possible viral inclusion obscuring them)
Narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Second, smaller early erythroblast with dense basophilic cytoplasmic rim; paucity of maturing erythroid precursors
10754.describe_en: Smear shows a giant pronormoblast, markedly larger than an adjacent segmented neutrophil, with a round nucleus containing finely dispersed homogeneous glassy chromatin and a narrow rim of intensely basophilic cytoplasm; a smaller early erythroblast with similar features is also present. Maturing erythroid precursors are not seen in these fields. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection with pure red cell aplasia/transient aplastic crisis; parvovirus B19 PCR and reticulocyte count are recommended, and the image alone cannot confirm the viral inclusions.

ddx.vs: Erythroid leukemia shows sheets of dysplastic proerythroblasts with vacuolated cytoplasm and >80% erythroid cells rather than scattered giant pronormoblasts in an erythroid-depleted marrow.
Megaloblastic change affects all maturation stages with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and hypersegmented neutrophils, not isolated giant early precursors.
Blasts have lighter blue cytoplasm and often nucleoli and are negative for erythroid markers (E-cadherin, glycophorin), unlike deeply basophilic pronormoblasts.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor cells
ddx.vs: Tumor cells occur in cohesive clusters and lack the intense basophilic cytoplasmic rim and erythroid markers.

22786.recognize_zh: 背景為大量染色質塊狀、細胞質稀少的小型成熟淋巴球（CLL）；左下一顆明顯變大的紅血球內含多個環狀體與變形蟲樣滋養體，插圖中紅血球內有帶褐色瘧色素的成熟滋養體/裂殖體，符合間日瘧（P. vivax）。
features: Many small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm (CLL background)
Enlarged pale erythrocyte containing multiple ring and irregular amoeboid trophozoites with chromatin dots
Inset: parasitized red cell with a mature trophozoite/schizont containing golden-brown hemozoin pigment
Many crenated erythrocytes (echinocytes)
Schüffner stippling is not clearly resolved at this magnification
22786.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked population of small mature lymphocytes with condensed, clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, consistent with the known chronic lymphocytic leukemia. An enlarged erythrocyte contains multiple ring forms and amoeboid trophozoites, and the inset shows a parasitized red cell harboring a pigmented mature trophozoite/schizont. Many echinocytes are present; Schüffner dots are not clearly resolved. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax infection in a patient with CLL; species should be confirmed by PCR or rapid antigen testing with a parasitemia estimate.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum parasitizes normal-sized red cells with delicate double-chromatin rings and crescentic gametocytes, and late forms are rarely seen in blood.
P. ovale also enlarges red cells but produces oval, fimbriated host cells with prominent James dots.
Babesia forms small pleomorphic rings and tetrad (Maltese cross) forms without hemozoin pigment or schizonts.
P. knowlesi does not enlarge red cells and shows band forms resembling P. malariae, so PCR is needed in endemic regions.

19394.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中小型、染色質粗塊狀的 CLL 淋巴球與污斑細胞之間，混有兩顆細胞質豐富淡藍、核較大且染色質較開放的大型淋巴樣細胞，大小與形態明顯不一，符合 CLL 混合細胞型。
features: Mixture of small lymphocytes with dense clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Two large lymphoid cells with abundant pale-blue cytoplasm, oval nuclei, and more open chromatin (center)
Medium-sized lymphoid cell with a moderate rim of cytoplasm and slightly indented nucleus (lower right)
Smudge cell (upper right) and a mature segmented neutrophil for size comparison
Red cells normocytic with drying artifact
19394.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphoid population of variable size, comprising small lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, medium-sized cells, and larger lymphoid cells with abundant pale-blue cytoplasm and more open chromatin. A smudge cell and a mature neutrophil are also present. Red cells are unremarkable aside from drying artifact. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia of mixed cell type; the proportion of larger cells and prolymphocytes should be quantified, and mantle cell lymphoma and other CD5-positive neoplasms should be excluded by immunophenotyping and cyclin D1/t(11;14) studies.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma is cyclin D1/SOX11 positive with t(11;14) and typically CD23-negative, a distinction morphology cannot make reliably in atypical CLL.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular or atypical lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells in a polyclonal background without numerous smudge cells or small clumped-chromatin lymphocytes.
SMZL lymphocytes show polar villous projections and plasmacytoid differentiation and are generally CD5-negative and CD23-negative.

17922.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆大型異常淋巴細胞，細胞核深度分葉呈花瓣狀，染色質細緻、細胞質灰藍並有細小空泡；旁邊另一顆較小、核深染有凹陷的異常淋巴細胞，放在 ALK 陰性 ALCL 白血病期的脈絡下代表腫瘤細胞進入血液。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cell, about twice the diameter of adjacent RBCs
Deeply lobulated, flower-like (multilobated) nucleus with relatively fine chromatin
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and a few small granules
Adjacent smaller cell with dense chromatin and a notched, cerebriform-appearing nucleus
Background RBCs without specific abnormality; image focus is soft at high magnification
17922.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, high power, shows a large atypical lymphoid cell with a markedly lobulated, flower-like nucleus, relatively fine chromatin and moderate grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm. An adjacent smaller cell has dense chromatin and an indented nuclear contour. The appearance of circulating large pleomorphic, lobulated lymphoid cells is nonspecific by morphology alone and requires immunophenotyping (CD30, loss of T-cell antigens, ALK) for classification. In the given clinical context, findings are consistent with leukemic involvement by ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells are usually smaller with condensed chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm, are CD25-positive with HTLV-1 serology, and lack uniform strong CD30.
Sezary cells show cerebriform grooved nuclei with dense chromatin rather than large lobated nuclei with fine chromatin, and are CD4+ CD7- CD26- without strong CD30.
Morphology cannot separate them; ALK immunostain or ALK rearrangement by FISH is required.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei with nucleoli and fine granules but express CD33, CD64 and lysozyme and lack T-cell markers.

14466.recognize_zh: 心臟移植後貧血的骨髓抹片可見多個巨大原紅血球（giant pronormoblast），細胞質深藍帶小泡突且缺乏後續成熟階段的紅血球；切片中有核內玻璃樣病毒包涵體，parvovirus B19 免疫染色陽性，符合 B19 誘發的純紅血球再生不良（pure red cell aplasia）。
features: BM aspirate: scattered giant pronormoblasts, markedly larger than surrounding cells, with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and cytoplasmic blebs
Giant pronormoblasts have fine chromatin and large nucleoli-like intranuclear clearing
Paucity of maturing erythroid precursors (few basophilic to orthochromatic normoblasts)
BM biopsy (H&E): large erythroid precursors with glassy eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions ('lantern cells')
IHC: nuclear/cytoplasmic parvovirus B19 staining in an infected erythroid precursor
14466.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate shows scattered giant pronormoblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, cytoplasmic blebs, and finely dispersed chromatin, with a striking paucity of later-stage erythroid precursors; myeloid cells and megakaryocytes are present. The trephine biopsy shows enlarged erythroid precursors containing glassy, amphophilic intranuclear viral inclusions with peripheral chromatin margination. Immunohistochemistry for parvovirus B19 highlights infected erythroid cells. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19-induced pure red cell aplasia in an immunosuppressed transplant recipient.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proerythroblasts (>80% erythroid, >=30% proerythroblasts) with dysplasia rather than scattered giant pronormoblasts with viral inclusions and absent maturation.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia or metastatic tumor
ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts and tumor cells form clusters and are CD61/CD42b or cytokeratin positive, lacking B19 immunostaining and intranuclear inclusions.

ddx.dx: Drug- or thymoma-associated (immune) pure red cell aplasia
ddx.vs: Immune PRCA shows absent erythroid precursors without giant pronormoblasts, viral inclusions, or B19 DNA.
CMV produces enlarged endothelial or stromal cells with owl-eye intranuclear plus granular cytoplasmic inclusions and is CMV IHC positive rather than B19 positive.

13506.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維銀染色下，黑色纖維在整個骨髓腔中瀰漫、密集交錯成網，並有粗厚成束、呈流線狀排列的纖維，只剩少數脂肪空腔；這種瀰漫高密度且粗纖維增生（約 MF-2 至 MF-3）是原發性骨髓纖維化纖維化期的特徵。
features: Diffuse, dense increase in reticulin fibers throughout the marrow space
Extensive intersections forming a tight meshwork around individual cells
Coarse, thickened fiber bundles with a streaming, parallel arrangement
Background cells pale pink on counterstain with few residual fat spaces
Collagen deposition and osteosclerosis cannot be assessed on this stain alone
13506.describe_en: Reticulin-stained bone marrow trephine section shows a diffuse and dense increase in reticulin fibers with extensive intersections and coarse, thickened bundles arranged in a streaming pattern, enveloping residual hematopoietic cells. Few fat spaces remain. The degree of fibrosis corresponds to at least MF-2, and MF-3 if accompanied by collagen and osteosclerosis on trichrome and H&E. Findings are consistent with advanced marrow fibrosis, as seen in the fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis; correlation with megakaryocyte morphology and JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation status is required.

ddx.dx: Post-polycythemia vera or post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis
ddx.vs: The reticulin pattern is indistinguishable; the prior documented PV or ET history defines secondary myelofibrosis.
Hairy cell leukemia shows fine, evenly spaced reticulin around a CD20+ annexin A1+ infiltrate rather than coarse streaming bundles.
MDS with fibrosis has small hypolobated megakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia rather than the clustered bizarre megakaryocytes of PMF.
Carcinoma shows cohesive epithelial clusters that are keratin positive within the fibrotic stroma.

13442.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中幾乎全是橢圓形紅血球（elliptocytes），並混有大量紅血球碎片、微球形紅血球（microspherocytes）與出芽狀、奇形怪狀的變形紅血球，符合遺傳性熱變形紅血球症（HPP）的極端異形表現。
features: Marked red cell poikilocytosis dominated by elliptocytes and ovalocytes
Numerous small red cell fragments and budding/irregular poikilocytes
Scattered microspherocytes lacking central pallor
Anisocytosis with many cells much smaller than normal (microcytosis)
Occasional platelets; a single band/segmented neutrophil appears morphologically unremarkable
No nucleated red cells or parasites identified in this field
13442.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows striking poikilocytosis with a predominance of elliptocytes and ovalocytes. There are numerous red cell fragments, budding and bizarre poikilocytes, and scattered microspherocytes, with marked anisocytosis. The single neutrophil and the platelets are unremarkable, and no red cell inclusions or parasites are seen. Findings are consistent with hereditary pyropoikilocytosis in the appropriate clinical setting (severe hemolytic anemia, markedly low MCV, spectrin defect); confirmation by red cell membrane studies (eg, EMA binding, ektacytometry, or genetic testing) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Common HE shows uniform elliptocytes with few fragments or microspherocytes and usually mild or no anemia, whereas HPP has abundant fragments, microspherocytes and extreme microcytosis.
MAHA shows schistocytes (helmet cells) with thrombocytopenia and polychromasia but not a background dominated by elliptocytes.
Burn-related red cell budding and microspherocytes are acute and transient in a clinical burn setting, without a lifelong hereditary elliptocytic background.
HS shows round spherocytes without the prominent elliptocytes and bizarre fragments seen here.

1794.recognize_zh: 組織切片中成片的大型組織球，細胞質豐富、淡灰粉紅色帶細緻纖維狀紋路，細胞核小而偏位，取代了左側殘存的造血細胞，是切片上高雪細胞（Gaucher cells）的典型表現。
features: Sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale gray-pink cytoplasm
Finely fibrillary, faintly striated cytoplasmic texture
Small, round to oval, eccentric nuclei with fine chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
Distinct cell borders forming a mosaic-like sheet
Residual hematopoietic cells and erythrocytes at the periphery
1794.describe_en: Section (H&E), most likely bone marrow biopsy, shows sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale gray-pink, finely fibrillary cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei, replacing the marrow space. Residual hematopoietic elements are compressed at the periphery. No cytologic atypia or mitotic activity is evident. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cell infiltration in Gaucher disease; enzyme assay or GBA1 genotyping is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; normal glucocerebrosidase activity and evidence of the underlying disorder separate them.
Striated histiocytes filled with acid-fast bacilli are identified by Ziehl-Neelsen or Fite stain.
Niemann-Pick cells show bubbly vacuolated foamy cytoplasm rather than fibrillary cytoplasm.
Histiocytes contain eosinophilic crystalline immunoglobulin inclusions associated with a clonal plasma cell or B-cell neoplasm.

1666.recognize_zh: 中央一顆大細胞有五個圓形核，細胞質豐富偏藍灰並有細小空泡，屬於多核漿細胞（multinucleated plasma cell）；右側另一顆偏心核、細胞質豐富含空泡的漿細胞支持其漿細胞來源。
features: Large multinucleated cell containing five round-to-oval nuclei of varying size
Nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin; no prominent nucleoli
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and irregular budding margins
Adjacent plasma cell with eccentric nucleus and abundant vacuolated cytoplasm
Background of smudged/degenerated cells and other hematopoietic cells
1666.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large multinucleated plasma cell containing five round nuclei with clumped chromatin within abundant grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm. A nearby plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus and vacuolated cytoplasm is also present, and the background contains degenerated cells. Multinucleated and atypical plasma cells are more frequent in plasma cell neoplasms, although the plasma cell percentage and clonality cannot be established from this single field. Findings are suggestive of an atypical plasma cell population, as seen in plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain many more, uniform, separate nuclei with single nucleoli and lack the perinuclear hof and eccentric plasma cell nuclear morphology.
Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus rather than discrete separate nuclei, and show granular pink cytoplasm with platelet budding.
Reactive plasma cells are small and mature, polytypic by light chain studies, and multinucleated forms are rare; clonality requires kappa/lambda restriction on flow or IHC.

1346.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片細胞量豐富，散佈好幾顆大型的巨核細胞（megakaryocytes），數量正常至增加；在 TTP 中這代表周邊血小板被消耗、骨髓巨核細胞代償，並非 TTP 特有的型態。
features: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear with cellular spread
Several megakaryocytes present, normal to increased in number, with lobulated nuclei
Numerous small hematopoietic cells scattered between red cell streaks
No abnormal clusters or blasts identifiable at this magnification
Cytologic detail limited by low magnification
1346.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with numerous hematopoietic cells dispersed among red cells. Megakaryocytes are readily identified and appear normal to increased in number, without obvious clustering. Detailed evaluation of erythroid hyperplasia or megakaryocytic morphology requires higher magnification. Findings are consistent with adequate to increased megakaryopoiesis, supporting a peripheral consumptive cause of thrombocytopenia such as thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura, but are not specific.

ddx.vs: ITP also shows increased megakaryocytes; separation depends on schistocytes, hemolysis markers and ADAMTS13 activity in TTP.
Production failure shows reduced or absent megakaryocytes, which argues against consumption.
MPN megakaryocytes are clustered and atypical, with thrombocytosis rather than thrombocytopenia.

2946.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抽吸抹片以血液為主、有核細胞稀少，但可見兩顆大型多核細胞，許多圓形核聚成一團、核彼此分開不重疊，符合破骨細胞（osteoclast），反映腎性骨病變中骨吸收增加。
features: Two large multinucleated cells with numerous discrete, round, uniform nuclei clustered together
Nuclei are separate rather than overlapping or lobulated, favoring osteoclasts over megakaryocytes
Moderate amount of pale purple cytoplasm surrounding the nuclear clusters
Hemodilute background with abundant red cells and sparse scattered nucleated cells
2946.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hemodilute specimen with abundant red cells and sparse nucleated hematopoietic cells. Two large multinucleated cells are present, each containing numerous discrete, uniform, round nuclei within a moderate amount of pale purple cytoplasm. The separate, non-overlapping nuclei favor osteoclasts over megakaryocytes. Cellular detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of increased osteoclasts, compatible with increased bone resorption as in renal osteodystrophy.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated, overlapping nucleus with granular cytoplasm, whereas osteoclasts have many separate, uniform round nuclei.
Tumor clusters consist of individual cohesive cells with their own cell borders and nuclear pleomorphism rather than one shared cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Multinucleated giant cells of granulomatous disease
ddx.vs: Langhans or foreign-body giant cells occur with epithelioid histiocytes and have peripherally arranged nuclei, which requires biopsy correlation.

1410.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散布許多漿細胞：核偏心、染色質粗塊、細胞質深藍且有核旁淡染區（hof），數量明顯增加並混在顆粒球系細胞之間，符合漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei
Coarse, clumped chromatin; occasional binucleate forms
Abundant basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof
Admixed maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, bands and neutrophils)
Scattered fat vacuoles in a particle-rich aspirate
1410.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows increased plasma cells interspersed among maturing granulocytic elements. The plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof, and occasional binucleate forms are seen. Granulocytic maturation appears preserved in this field. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm such as plasma cell myeloma; quantification of plasma cells and demonstration of light chain restriction are needed.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are usually mature, fewer (often <10%) and polytypic on kappa/lambda staining, whereas neoplastic cells show light chain restriction.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells, usually with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.
Erythroid precursors have central round nuclei with a thin rim of deep-blue cytoplasm and lack the eccentric nucleus with Golgi hof.

1218.recognize_zh: 抽吸液被兩群細胞混合佔據：一群核摺疊或腎形、胞質灰藍帶細顆粒的單核系細胞（promonocytes），另一群核圓、胞質較少的母細胞，其間夾雜少數成熟中的顆粒球；顆粒系與單核系同時增生，符合 AMML。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with a mixed population of immature cells
Many cells with folded, indented or reniform nuclei, delicate chromatin and gray-blue finely granular cytoplasm (promonocytes/monocytes)
Admixed round-nucleated blasts with fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Scattered maturing granulocytes including myelocytes and occasional segmented neutrophils
Occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles; erythroid precursors sparse
1218.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and composed of a mixed population of immature myeloid and monocytic cells. A large proportion of cells have gray-blue, finely granular cytoplasm and folded, indented or kidney-shaped nuclei with delicate chromatin, consistent with promonocytes and immature monocytes. These are admixed with round-nucleated myeloblasts and a smaller component of maturing granulocytes, while erythroid precursors are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia, to be confirmed by MPO and nonspecific esterase cytochemistry or flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Monocytic cells account for >=80% with minimal granulocytic component, whereas neutrophil-lineage blasts and maturing granulocytes are evident here.
Shares myelomonocytic morphology but contains abnormal eosinophils with large basophilic granules and is defined by CBFB::MYH11.
CMML has mostly mature monocytes and <20% blasts plus promonocytes, not a field dominated by immature forms.

1282.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有兩顆大型非典型細胞，核偏心、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，細胞質深藍且外緣有少量細小紅紫色顆粒，與右側較小的造血細胞明顯不同；此為可疑淋巴瘤細胞，但形態上無法確定為 NK/T 譜系。
features: Two large atypical cells, much larger than neighboring hematopoietic cells
Moderate N:C ratio with eccentrically placed round nuclei
Finely granular chromatin with small nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a faint paler perinuclear zone and sparse fine azurophilic granules
Background of residual myeloid cells, a neutrophil and clumped red cells in a thick, poorly spread area
1282.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear, in a thick and suboptimally spread area, shows two large atypical cells among residual hematopoietic elements. The cells have eccentric round nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing sparse fine azurophilic granules. Their appearance is plasmablast-like, and lineage cannot be assigned on morphology alone. Immunophenotyping (cytoplasmic CD3, CD56, cytotoxic markers, CD138) and EBER in situ hybridization are required. Findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by lymphoma, compatible with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma in the clinical context.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: Plasmablastic cells can look identical with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm; they are CD138/MUM1-positive and CD56 may overlap, so immunostaining is essential.
Proerythroblasts have very dark blue cytoplasm with blebs and centrally placed round nuclei, lack azurophilic granules and are CD71/E-cadherin positive.
Myeloblasts have finer blast chromatin, may show Auer rods and express MPO/CD34/CD117 rather than cytoplasmic CD3 and CD56.
Morphologically similar; the distinction is clinical (systemic leukemic presentation) rather than cytologic.

1090.recognize_zh: 中央一顆大型中性球，核分成九葉以上（hypersegmentation），旁邊有大片血小板團塊，屬於 JMML 周邊血中可見的發育不良（dysplasia）變化。
features: Large neutrophil with markedly hypersegmented nucleus (more than 6 lobes)
Fine pink granular cytoplasm of normal neutrophil type
Adjacent large platelet aggregate/megakaryocyte fragment with purple granular center
Scattered single platelets, some large
Red cells with occasional crenated forms and stomatocyte-like cells
1090.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large neutrophil with a markedly hypersegmented nucleus containing numerous lobes, adjacent to a large platelet aggregate. Scattered platelets, some enlarged, are present, and red cells show mild crenation. The hypersegmented neutrophil represents a dysplastic granulocyte, which can be seen in juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia but is not specific by itself. Correlation with monocytosis, hemoglobin F and genetic studies is required.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows hypersegmented neutrophils with oval macrocytes and no monocytosis; B12/folate levels separate it.
Drug-related hypersegmentation occurs with macrocytosis and clinical exposure history rather than a myelomonocytic proliferation.
MDS shows multilineage dysplasia with cytopenias but lacks the monocytosis and RAS-pathway alterations of JMML.

1026.recognize_zh: 大型原紅血球胞質深藍、部分含小空泡，並可見核分裂像（上方）與成熟中紅血球母細胞；紅血球系前驅細胞壓倒性增多，符合急性紅血球白血病。
features: Predominance of large proerythroblasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and small nucleoli
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm with scattered small clear vacuoles
Mitotic figure present, indicating proliferative activity
Admixed maturing erythroblasts with checkered chromatin and some binucleated forms
Rare granulocytes, including a neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus
1026.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a dense population of immature erythroid precursors. Many large proerythroblasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and deeply basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm are present, together with a mitotic figure and maturing erythroblasts, some binucleated. Granulocytic cells are rare. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia; immunophenotyping (CD71, glycophorin A, E-cadherin) and a differential count are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells also have basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but are medium-sized B cells (CD19/CD10/sIg positive) without an accompanying erythroid maturation series.
Megaloblastic change affects all lineages with giant metamyelocytes and orderly maturation rather than a proerythroblast-dominant population.
Megakaryoblasts show cytoplasmic blebs and express CD41/CD61, not erythroid markers.

4226.recognize_zh: 視野上方一顆紅血球內有橢圓到略長形的蟲體，胞質淡藍、中央有深褐黑色瘧色素團，形狀較像尚未完全變成香蕉形的惡性瘧配子體；其餘紅血球大小一致、未明顯增大。
features: Single intraerythrocytic parasite with an elongated oval shape and pale blue cytoplasm
Central clumped dark brown-black hemozoin pigment within the parasite
Infected red cell is not enlarged and lacks Schuffner dots
A few small purple dot-like structures over red cells and background are nonspecific (possible platelets or precipitate)
Red cells show thick-area overlap and drying artifact
4226.describe_en: Smear shows a single elongated oval intraerythrocytic parasite with pale blue cytoplasm and a central clump of dark hemozoin pigment, within a red cell that is not enlarged and lacks stippling. The morphology favors a developing gametocyte of Plasmodium falciparum, although the classic crescent shape is not fully developed in this example. No definite ring forms are identified in this field; a few small purple dots in the background are nonspecific. Findings are consistent with falciparum malaria in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Vivax and ovale stages occupy enlarged red cells with Schuffner dots, and their gametocytes are round rather than elongated.
P. malariae band trophozoites stretch across a normal-sized red cell as a band with coarse pigment, whereas falciparum gametocytes are sausage- or crescent-shaped and may distort the cell.
Babesia shows small pleomorphic rings and tetrads with no hemozoin pigment.

4098.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中央有一顆與淋巴球差不多大小的細胞，核圓而深染、細胞質淡藍並有不規則的出芽狀突起與顆粒，形態符合小巨核細胞（micromegakaryocyte）；背景血小板增多且大小不一。
features: Lymphocyte-sized cell with a single round dense nucleus
Rim of pale blue-gray cytoplasm with irregular budding edges and fine azurophilic granules (platelet shedding)
Background thrombocytosis with platelet anisocytosis, including large platelets
Mature segmented and band neutrophils present
Red cells mostly normocytic; lymphocyte-like size can cause misclassification
4098.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small cell, approximately the size of a lymphocyte, with a round hyperchromatic nucleus and a scant rim of pale gray-blue cytoplasm with ragged, budding margins and fine granules, consistent with a circulating micromegakaryocyte. Platelets are increased with variation in size, and mature neutrophils are seen. Circulating micromegakaryocytes indicate a myeloid neoplasm such as chronic myeloid leukemia or myelofibrosis in this setting; correlation with BCR-ABL1 testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have smooth cytoplasmic borders without platelet-like budding and lack the granular gray cytoplasm; CD41/CD61 staining confirms megakaryocytic origin.
Blasts have finer open chromatin and nucleoli with basophilic cytoplasm rather than dense chromatin and platelet-shedding edges.
Bare megakaryocyte nuclei lack any cytoplasmic rim and are usually larger and lobulated.

4034.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見多顆大型單核球系細胞，核呈圓形至摺疊、染色質細緻，細胞質豐富灰藍並有偽足狀突起；這些不成熟單核細胞提示急性單核球性白血病，但此圖並未看到噬血現象（hemophagocytosis），HLH 需靠骨髓與臨床指標佐證。
features: Large mononuclear cells with round to indented or folded nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin, suggesting immature monocytes (promonocytes/monoblasts)
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with ruffled borders and pseudopod-like blebs, few fine granules
One binucleate-appearing pair of adjacent monocytic cells
No hemophagocytosis, neutrophils, or nucleated red cells in this field; red cells unremarkable
4034.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large monocytic cells with round to folded nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular, blebbed borders. The fine chromatin suggests immature monocytic forms, although nucleoli are not well resolved at this magnification. Hemophagocytosis is not seen in this field, so the HLH component of the title cannot be confirmed from this image. Findings are suggestive of circulating immature monocytic cells, compatible with acute monocytic leukemia; blast enumeration, cytochemistry (nonspecific esterase) and flow cytometry are needed.

ddx.vs: Mature monocytes have more condensed, lacy chromatin with vacuoles and indented nuclei, whereas promonocytes and monoblasts have finer chromatin and visible nucleoli.
CMML shows predominantly mature monocytes with fewer than 20% blasts plus promonocytes and frequently granulocytic dysplasia.
Reactive lymphocytes have deeper basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and lack the folded nuclei and gray ruffled cytoplasm of monocytes; flow cytometry settles ambiguous cases.

3970.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中可見一團緊密聚集的上皮樣組織球（epithelioid histiocytes），細胞核呈長橢圓或腎形、細胞質淡藍且邊界不清而呈融合狀，周圍為一般造血細胞，即為肉芽腫。
features: Cohesive syncytial cluster of epithelioid histiocytes
Oval to elongated, bean-shaped nuclei with fine, pale chromatin
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
No multinucleated giant cells or necrosis evident in this field
No visible intracellular organisms at this magnification
Background of trilineage hematopoietic precursors and small lymphocytes
3970.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant pale, poorly demarcated cytoplasm forming a syncytium. The surrounding marrow elements include maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes. No multinucleated giant cells, necrosis or intracellular organisms are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a granuloma; special stains for organisms and cultures are recommended to exclude infection.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma clusters show true cohesion with sharp cell borders, larger pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli, rather than bland bean-shaped histiocytic nuclei in a syncytium.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a paranuclear hof and osteoclasts are single multinucleated cells, whereas epithelioid histiocytes form a syncytial aggregate of elongated nuclei.
Morphology of the granuloma is similar; GMS, AFB stains, culture or PCR are needed to identify a specific organism.
Hemophagocytic macrophages are dispersed single cells containing ingested blood cells, not cohesive aggregates of epithelioid cells.

3906.recognize_zh: 周邊血中間那顆大細胞胞質深藍、邊緣清楚，核染色質細緻開放並有數個核仁；兩側的細胞已破裂只剩裸核，這種大型、胞質強嗜鹼性又易碎的淋巴樣細胞符合大細胞淋巴瘤的白血病期。
features: Large lymphoid cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and high N:C ratio
Round to oval nucleus with open, vesicular chromatin and multiple small nucleoli
Adjacent fragile cells present as disrupted/bare nuclei with smudged chromatin
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Background red cells with an echinocyte and drying artifacts
3906.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large atypical lymphoid cell with an oval nucleus, open vesicular chromatin, multiple small nucleoli and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Two neighboring cells are disrupted with smudged chromatin and little residual cytoplasm, indicating fragility. No granules or Auer rods are present. Findings are consistent with circulating large lymphoma cells, supporting a leukemic phase of large B-cell lymphoma; flow cytometry is needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Blasts typically have less intensely basophilic cytoplasm and finer, more homogeneous chromatin, and they express immaturity markers such as CD34 or TdT.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a paranuclear hof and are CD138-positive and CD20-negative.
Reactive immunoblasts are admixed with a spectrum of reactive lymphocytes and are polyclonal on flow cytometry.

3778.recognize_zh: 兩顆嗜中性球細胞質有粗大毒性顆粒，下方那顆的細胞質邊緣有淡藍色、形狀不規則的斑塊，即 Döhle 小體（粗面內質網殘留），常見於感染或發炎。
features: Two adjacent neutrophils (segmented and band forms) of normal size
Pale blue, irregular, peripherally located cytoplasmic patches (Döhle bodies), best seen in the lower cell
Coarse, dark azurophilic cytoplasmic granules (toxic granulation)
Nuclear lobes with condensed clumped chromatin
Background red cells include an occasional crenated (echinocytic) cell; platelets not increased
3778.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with prominent coarse cytoplasmic granulation and pale blue, irregularly shaped peripheral cytoplasmic inclusions consistent with Döhle bodies. Nuclear segmentation is normal to slightly reduced, and no giant platelets are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with toxic changes of neutrophils (Döhle bodies and toxic granulation), as seen in infection, inflammation, pregnancy or growth factor therapy.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger, more sharply defined, spindle-shaped, present in most neutrophils and accompanied by giant platelets and thrombocytopenia.
Alder-Reilly granules are inherited dark granules in all leukocytes without blue cytoplasmic patches.
Morulae are dark purple, stippled mulberry-like clusters rather than pale blue homogeneous patches.

3586.recognize_zh: 高倍下一顆淋巴球，圓形偏心的細胞核染色質成塊，最明顯的是豐富的淡藍色細胞質中散佈十餘顆大小不一的紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），這就是大顆粒淋巴球（large granular lymphocyte, LGL）。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte, roughly 1.5 times an RBC
Round, eccentric nucleus with coarse, clumped chromatin; no nucleoli
Moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm (low N:C ratio relative to small lymphocytes)
Numerous coarse azurophilic red-purple granules scattered in the cytoplasm
Small cytoplasmic projections at the cell border; adjacent platelet
3586.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a large granular lymphocyte with a round, eccentrically placed nucleus containing coarsely clumped chromatin and no nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderate to abundant and pale blue, containing numerous coarse azurophilic granules. Background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings represent large granular lymphocyte morphology (cytotoxic T or NK cell); a sustained LGL count above approximately 2 x 10^9/L, especially with cytopenias, would warrant flow cytometry and TCR/STAT3 studies for T-LGL leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have deeper basophilic cytoplasm hugging neighboring RBCs and generally lack discrete azurophilic granules.
Promyelocytes are larger with finer chromatin, visible nucleoli, a perinuclear hof and far more abundant granules.
Hairy cells have circumferential hair-like projections, bean-shaped nuclei with finer chromatin and no azurophilic granules.

3650.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞豐富，顆粒球系各成熟階段（骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀核、分葉核）都有，另有成群、核深染圓形的紅血球前驅細胞與少數淋巴球；各系成熟有序、無芽細胞增加，符合正常成人骨髓。
features: Cellular aspirate with mixed granulocytic and erythroid precursors
Granulocytes show orderly maturation from myelocytes to segmented neutrophils
Erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei, some in small clusters
Occasional small lymphocytes; no increase in blasts
Fat vacuoles at the edges of the spread; no megakaryocyte in this field
3650.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular spread with trilineage hematopoietic elements. Granulocytic precursors show orderly maturation from myelocytes through segmented neutrophils, and erythroid precursors, some in small clusters, show normal maturation with round dense nuclei. Scattered lymphocytes are present, blasts are not increased, and no dysplasia or abnormal infiltrate is identified; megakaryocytes are not represented in this field. Findings are consistent with normal adult bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Features a reversed myeloid-to-erythroid ratio with sheets of erythroid precursors, not the balanced mixture seen here.
Requires dysplastic morphology such as nuclear budding, megaloblastoid change, or hypogranular neutrophils.
Shows a monotonous population of small lymphocytes forming a substantial proportion of cells, confirmed by flow cytometry.

3714.recognize_zh: 一小群大型細胞，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色、邊界模糊，細胞核圓至橢圓且偏於一側、染色質細緻並有小核仁，核旁可見遠離細胞核的淡染區，呈彗星狀排列，是骨母細胞（osteoblasts）而非漿細胞或腫瘤細胞。
features: Cluster of large cells, several times the size of red cells, with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Round to oval eccentric nuclei with fine reticular chromatin and small nucleoli
Pale perinuclear (Golgi) clear zone located away from the nucleus
Comet- or tadpole-like cell shapes with the nucleus at one end
Background red cells with drying (refractile bubble) artifact and a few normal marrow cells
3714.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a loose cluster of large cells with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, eccentric round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, and a pale Golgi zone separated from the nucleus. The cells lack significant pleomorphism, hyperchromasia or nuclear molding. Adjacent red cells show drying artifact, and a small lymphocyte and scattered hematopoietic cells are present. Findings are consistent with osteoblasts, which are more common in aspirates from children and in conditions with active bone remodeling.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells are smaller with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, clumped clock-face chromatin and a hof immediately adjacent to the nucleus, whereas osteoblasts are larger with a Golgi zone set apart from the nucleus.
Show cohesive clusters with nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, molding and prominent nucleoli, rather than bland uniform nuclei with fine chromatin.
Are very large multinucleated cells with multiple separate uniform nuclei and granular cytoplasm, whereas each osteoblast has a single nucleus.

3522.recognize_zh: 高倍下以各階段成熟的顆粒球系細胞（中晚幼粒、帶狀核、分葉核）為主，混有一些中型、染色質粗糙、核形略不規則的淋巴樣細胞；本圖形態本身不足以確立 T 細胞淋巴瘤，需免疫表型佐證。
features: Numerous maturing granulocytic cells: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, and segmented neutrophils
Scattered small to medium mononuclear cells with coarse chromatin and slightly irregular nuclei, some possibly atypical lymphoid cells
Round erythroid precursors with dense chromatin
Occasional eosinophil and monocytoid cell
No definite population of large atypical cells in this field
3522.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows abundant maturing granulocytic elements with orderly progression to segmented neutrophils, along with erythroid precursors and an occasional eosinophil. Admixed are small to medium mononuclear cells with coarse chromatin and mildly irregular nuclear contours, which may represent atypical T cells, although they are not morphologically distinctive. Correlation with trephine biopsy immunohistochemistry, flow cytometry, and T-cell receptor gene rearrangement studies is required to establish involvement by peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrow lacks an aberrant T-cell population on flow cytometry and shows polyclonal TCR studies.
CML shows a myelocyte bulge with basophilia and BCR::ABL1, rather than atypical lymphoid infiltration.
Hematogones have smooth homogeneous chromatin and a maturing B-precursor immunophenotype, not a T-cell phenotype.

3458.recognize_zh: 骨髓幾乎被大量單一形態的異常前骨髓細胞取代，細胞質含紫紅色嗜苯胺顆粒，核呈腎形、折疊或雙葉，缺乏正常成熟的顆粒球，符合急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）。
features: Hypercellular aspirate replaced by a monotonous population of large abnormal promyelocytes
Moderate to abundant cytoplasm with fine to coarse azurophilic granules
Nuclei reniform, folded, or bilobed with fine chromatin
Scattered small dark erythroid precursors or lymphocytes; normal granulocytic maturation markedly reduced
Auer rods not clearly resolved at this magnification
3458.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and largely replaced by a monotonous population of large abnormal promyelocytes with moderate to abundant cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules and reniform, folded, or bilobed nuclei with fine chromatin. Normal maturing granulocytes are markedly reduced, with only scattered small erythroid precursors or lymphocytes. Auer rods cannot be resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent coagulation evaluation and confirmation of PML::RARA are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive promyelocytes have round nuclei with a Golgi hof and synchronous maturation, without bilobed nuclei or Auer rod bundles.
