AML with maturation has agranular blasts with a spectrum of maturing granulocytes, and lacks sheets of hypergranular abnormal promyelocytes.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei but grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and are nonspecific esterase positive with weak MPO.

3330.recognize_zh: 脾臟切片低倍下紅髓被單調的小至中型淋巴細胞瀰漫浸潤，白髓不明顯，細胞間散佈許多紅血球湖（blood lakes），這是毛細胞白血病及其變異型典型的紅髓浸潤樣式。
features: Diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells expanding the red pulp
Cells have round-to-oval nuclei with moderate pale cytoplasm giving a spaced-out appearance
Numerous irregular red cell collections (pseudosinuses/blood lakes) scattered among the infiltrate
White pulp not discernible; no nodular architecture
Individual nucleoli not resolvable at this magnification
3330.describe_en: Splenic section at low-to-medium power shows diffuse expansion of the red pulp by a monotonous infiltrate of small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with round-to-oval nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm. Numerous red cell-filled spaces (blood lakes) are scattered throughout, and discrete white pulp nodules are not identified. Nucleolar detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with red pulp involvement by a small B-cell neoplasm such as hairy cell leukemia variant; distinction from classic HCL requires peripheral blood morphology (prominent nucleoli), immunophenotype (CD25, annexin A1, CD123 negative) and BRAF V600E status.

ddx.vs: Classic HCL has an identical red pulp pattern with blood lakes but is CD25, CD123, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positive, whereas HCL variant lacks these.
SMZL predominantly expands the white pulp with a biphasic nodular pattern and marginal zone differentiation rather than diffuse red pulp infiltration.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL shares diffuse red pulp involvement and CD25/annexin A1 negativity, so separation from HCL variant relies on cytology (nucleoli), cyclin D3 and MAP2K1 mutation profile.
HSTCL shows sinusoidal red pulp infiltration by T cells (CD3+, TCR gamma-delta) with isochromosome 7q rather than B-cell markers.

3202.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有一個幾乎無胞質、染色質粗糙團塊狀的裸露巨核細胞核碎片，旁邊緊鄰大型顆粒狀巨大血小板，背景並見淚滴狀紅血球，符合骨髓纖維化時的巨核細胞碎片。
features: Small bare megakaryocytic nuclear fragment with dense, coarsely clumped purple chromatin and only a thin rim of cytoplasm
Adjacent giant platelets approaching or exceeding red cell size with finely granular pale-blue cytoplasm
Several normal-sized granular platelets scattered in the field
Occasional red cell containing small basophilic inclusions (Pappenheimer bodies or stippling)
Mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional teardrop and irregular red cells
3202.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating megakaryocyte fragment consisting of a dense, coarsely clumped nucleus with scant cytoplasm. Nearby are giant platelets with finely granular cytoplasm, one approaching the size of a red cell, along with normal-sized platelets. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional teardrop forms and a red cell with basophilic inclusions. Findings are consistent with circulating megakaryocyte fragments and giant platelets, as seen in primary myelofibrosis and other myeloproliferative neoplasms.

ddx.vs: A lymphocyte has a round nucleus with a distinct rim of blue cytoplasm and lacks the dense, irregular, clumped chromatin and adherent platelet material of a megakaryocyte fragment.
An orthochromatic normoblast has a round pyknotic nucleus within hemoglobinized orange-pink cytoplasm rather than granular platelet-like cytoplasm.
Micromegakaryocytes are intact small cells with a single round nucleus and mature granular cytoplasm, whereas a fragment is a disrupted bare nucleus with scant attached cytoplasm.

2818.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒球系增生，並有多顆染色質細緻、細胞質嗜鹼性的母細胞/早幼粒細胞，另可見嗜酸性骨髓細胞（紅色顆粒）與含黑色粗顆粒的嗜鹼性球，母細胞增加伴嗜鹼性球提示 CML 進展期。
features: Increased blasts and promyelocytes with fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm
Granulocytic maturation to bands and segmented neutrophils
Eosinophilic myelocyte with refractile orange-red granules
Basophil with coarse dark purple-black granules; a large cell with dense purple granules at upper right
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis
2818.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a granulocytic proliferation with an increased proportion of immature cells, including blasts with fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm, and promyelocytes. Maturing myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils are present, together with an eosinophilic myelocyte and basophils with coarse dark granules. A formal blast and basophil count is needed to confirm accelerated phase. In a patient with known BCR::ABL1-positive CML, the increased immature cells and basophils are consistent with disease progression (accelerated phase).

ddx.vs: Blast phase requires >=20% blasts; accelerated phase has 10-19% blasts in blood or marrow.
De novo AML with BCR::ABL1 lacks a preceding chronic phase and shows less basophilia and splenomegaly.
Abnormal eosinophils in inv(16) contain large purple-violet granules, with myelomonocytic blasts and no BCR::ABL1.
APL shows sheets of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and Auer rod bundles without a maturing granulocytic background.

2626.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以紅血球前驅細胞為主，可見雙核紅母細胞、核分葉或凹陷（核出芽）及染色質偏細緻的大型嗜鹼性紅母細胞，呈現紅血球系發育異常；環狀鐵粒母細胞仍需鐵染色證實。
features: Erythroid-predominant field with basophilic, polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts
Dyserythropoiesis: binucleated erythroid precursor and nuclei with lobation or notching
Large basophilic erythroblasts with megaloblastoid, finely stippled chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular cytoplasmic borders in some cells
Occasional granulocytic precursors; no increase in blasts evident
Ring sideroblasts not demonstrable without iron stain
2626.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid predominance with precursors at all stages of maturation. Several erythroid precursors show dysplastic features, including binucleation, nuclear lobation and notching, and megaloblastoid chromatin in large basophilic erythroblasts. Granulocytic precursors are present in small numbers, and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings indicate dyserythropoiesis consistent with myelodysplastic neoplasm with ring sideroblasts in the stated context; however, ring sideroblasts must be demonstrated and counted on a Prussian blue stain, and SF3B1 status determined.

ddx.vs: Vitamin B12 or folate deficiency causes similar megaloblastoid erythroblasts and binucleation but also giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils with low B12/folate levels.
CDA presents in younger patients with prominent internuclear bridges or multinucleation and lacks SF3B1 mutation and ring sideroblasts.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows >80% erythroid cells with at least 30% proerythroblasts, which are not present in this maturing population.

ddx.dx: Toxin- or drug-induced dyserythropoiesis (alcohol, arsenic, chemotherapy)
ddx.vs: Exposure history and resolution after removal of the agent separate reactive dysplasia from clonal MDS.

2498.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結切片中，被膜下與竇狀隙、副皮質區被大片淡粉紅色、胞質豐富的細胞浸潤，只殘留幾個深藍色的淋巴濾泡，這種以竇為主的淡染組織細胞擴張提示蘭格罕細胞組織球增生症（LCH）侵犯淋巴結。
features: Lymph node architecture partially effaced at low power
Subcapsular and intranodal sinuses/paracortex expanded by sheets of pale eosinophilic cells with abundant cytoplasm
Residual dark-staining lymphoid follicles and cords of small lymphocytes between the pale areas
Intact thin fibrous capsule at the top of the field
Individual nuclear grooves and eosinophils not resolvable at this magnification
2498.describe_en: Section of lymph node at low power shows partial effacement of the architecture by pale-staining infiltrates that distend the subcapsular and medullary sinuses and extend into the paracortex. Residual lymphoid follicles and bands of small lymphocytes remain between the pale sheets. Cytologic detail (nuclear grooves, eosinophils, necrosis) cannot be assessed at this magnification. The sinus-based histiocytic pattern is suggestive of nodal involvement by Langerhans cell histiocytosis; confirmation requires high-power morphology and CD1a/langerin (CD207) and S100 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Reactive sinus histiocytes lack grooved, folded nuclei and eosinophil-rich infiltrates and are CD1a and langerin negative.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are very large with emperipolesis and are S100 positive but CD1a and langerin negative.
Dermatopathic change expands the paracortex with a nodular mix of Langerhans cells, interdigitating cells and melanin-laden macrophages rather than filling sinuses with sheets of Langerhans cells.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30/CD15-positive Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background rather than sheets of CD1a-positive histiocytes.

2434.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中一條小血管的管腔被顆粒狀嗜酸性物質與空泡完全阻塞（血栓），周圍髓腔呈淡粉紅壞死狀，提示血管阻塞是這例骨髓壞死的可能機轉。
features: Small vessel with thickened, concentric eosinophilic wall
Lumen occluded by granular eosinophilic material with vacuolated, reticulated areas consistent with thrombus
Adjacent marrow shows pale eosinophilic cells with reduced nuclear staining (necrosis)
Bony trabecula at lower right; focal brown pigment in surrounding tissue
2434.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (H&E) at high power shows a small vessel with a thickened eosinophilic wall whose lumen is occluded by granular eosinophilic material with fibrin-like reticulation and clear vacuoles, consistent with a thrombus. The surrounding marrow shows pale eosinophilic cells with diminished nuclear staining, and an adjacent bony trabecula is present. No definite tumor cells are identified within the vessel at this magnification. Findings are consistent with vascular occlusion accompanying bone marrow necrosis; causes such as sickle cell vaso-occlusion, DIC/thrombotic microangiopathy, or tumor emboli should be considered clinically.

ddx.vs: A tumor embolus contains cohesive viable atypical cells with discrete nuclei, whereas this lumen contains anucleate granular and fibrin-like material.
Sickle crisis shows vessels packed with elongated sickled red cells; morphology of red cells and hemoglobin studies separate it from a bland fibrin thrombus.
Fat emboli leave empty clear round spaces (oil red O positive on fresh tissue) rather than granular eosinophilic fibrin.

2370.recognize_zh: 背景是大量淡色鬼影紅血球（HbA 已被酸洗脫），其間散布一群染成深洋紅色、內部均勻飽滿的紅血球，這些是抗酸的含 HbF 細胞，兩群對比清楚，是 Kleihauer-Betke 陽性的典型畫面。
features: Two distinct red cell populations: numerous pale ghost cells versus scattered intensely eosinophilic, homogeneously stained cells
Darkly stained HbF-containing cells make up roughly one-fifth of cells in this field
Many dark cells are crenated or irregular in outline (preparation artifact)
Ghost cells show only faint membrane outlines with empty interiors
Occasional ghost cell with faint residual granular staining (intermediate cell)
2370.describe_en: Kleihauer-Betke acid elution preparation shows a dimorphic red cell population. The majority of red cells are pale ghost cells in which acid-labile adult hemoglobin has been eluted, while a substantial subset of cells retain intense, homogeneous eosinophilic staining indicating acid-resistant fetal hemoglobin. Several positive cells are crenated, an expected artifact. Findings indicate HbF-containing red cells; in a maternal sample this pattern supports fetomaternal hemorrhage, and the fetal cell percentage should be counted to estimate bleed volume.

ddx.dx: Pancellular hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin
ddx.vs: Pancellular HPFH gives uniform staining of essentially all red cells, not a discrete subpopulation among ghost cells.

ddx.dx: Heterocellular HbF elevation (sickle cell disease, beta-thalassemia, pregnancy F cells)
ddx.vs: Maternal F cells tend to stain less intensely and more variably than true fetal cells; flow cytometry with anti-HbF and anti-carbonic anhydrase distinguishes them.
Cord or neonatal blood shows nearly all cells darkly stained, with only few ghost cells.

2178.recognize_zh: 中倍小腸黏膜絨毛變短、扭曲，固有層被密集的淋巴樣細胞浸潤而擴張，並延伸至表面上皮，隱窩結構紊亂；這種以黏膜為主的密集淋巴浸潤合併絨毛變形，是 EATL 切片的常見低倍線索。
features: Distorted, blunted small-intestinal villi
Lamina propria markedly expanded by a dense lymphoid infiltrate
Infiltrate extends into and disrupts surface and crypt epithelium
Crypt architecture irregular with congested vessels
Detached fragmented mucosa at the edge of the section; cytologic detail requires higher power
2178.describe_en: Medium-power section of small-intestinal mucosa shows blunted and distorted villi with marked expansion of the lamina propria by a dense lymphoid infiltrate that extends into the surface and crypt epithelium. Crypt architecture is irregular and vessels are congested; fragmented detached mucosa is present at the left of the field. Cytologic atypia cannot be fully assessed at this magnification. In conjunction with high-power morphology and a T-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma involving small-bowel mucosa.

ddx.vs: Celiac disease shows villous flattening with crypt hyperplasia and a polymorphous lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate without sheets of atypical T cells.
MEITL is composed of monotonous medium cells that are CD8+ CD56+, requiring IHC to separate from EATL.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the small bowel
ddx.vs: DLBCL consists of large CD20+ cells and generally lacks marked epitheliotropism.

2050.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 下整個淋巴結被大量大小相近、背靠背緊密排列的濾泡取代，濾泡從皮質一路分布到髓質，濾泡間組織極少，這種均一密集的濾泡性結構是濾泡性淋巴瘤的經典低倍影像。
features: Complete effacement of the node by innumerable closely packed, back-to-back follicles
Follicles of relatively uniform size and shape distributed evenly throughout cortex and medulla
Attenuated mantle zones and scant interfollicular tissue with thin fibrous septa
Follicles lack obvious polarization at this magnification
Capsule and adjacent hemorrhagic perinodal tissue at the lower edge
2050.describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows complete architectural effacement by numerous closely packed, back-to-back neoplastic follicles of relatively uniform size, distributed evenly throughout the node. Mantle zones are attenuated and interfollicular tissue is scant. Polarization cannot be appreciated at this magnification. The pattern is characteristic of follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed by cytology and BCL2/CD10 immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles are variable in size and shape, concentrated in the cortex, with well-formed mantles, polarization, tingible-body macrophages and BCL2-negative germinal centers.
MCL nodules are monotonous small cells that are CD5+ cyclin D1+ and CD10-negative.
NLPBL nodules are large and pale with scattered LP cells in a small-lymphocyte background rather than neoplastic germinal center cells.

1922.recognize_zh: 中央一顆雙核巨大的巨噬細胞，灰藍色胞質內含多個橘紅色、圓形的被吞噬紅血球；右上另一顆巨噬細胞胞質中也含一顆紅血球與小顆暗色碎片，這就是紅血球吞噬（erythrophagocytosis）。
features: Large binucleate macrophage with abundant grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm containing multiple engulfed round orange-pink red cells
Second macrophage (upper right) with one nucleus, an ingested red cell, and a small dark inclusion consistent with nuclear debris
Macrophage nuclei round to oval with coarse chromatin
Adjacent erythroid precursors, including polychromatic normoblasts with clumped chromatin and a small dark orthochromatic form, at left
Background red cells with crenated (echinocytic) and irregular forms
1922.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows two macrophages with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm; the larger, binucleate macrophage contains several intact phagocytosed red blood cells, and the second contains an ingested red cell and a small fragment of nuclear debris. Erythroid precursors are present nearby, and background red cells show crenation. Findings demonstrate erythrophagocytosis by macrophages, which may be seen in hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, immune hemolysis, infection, transfusion, or malignancy and must be interpreted with clinical and laboratory criteria rather than in isolation.

ddx.vs: Storage histiocytes contain lipid or ceroid (blue granules or wrinkled cytoplasm) rather than recognizable intact red cells.
Hemosiderin appears as coarse golden-brown to blue-black granules, confirmed by Prussian blue, rather than intact round erythrocytes.

ddx.dx: Tumor cells with emperipolesis (e.g., megakaryocyte or Rosai-Dorfman histiocyte)
ddx.vs: Emperipolesis shows intact cells passing within the cytoplasm without degradation, typically lymphocytes in S100-positive histiocytes or cells in megakaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Erythrophagocytosis by blasts (e.g., AML with t(8;16))
ddx.vs: In AML with KAT6A::CREBBP the phagocytic cells are monocytic blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli rather than mature macrophages.

1858.recognize_zh: 群聚的中型胚細胞核質比極高，只有極少量淡藍色細胞質，箭頭指出核膜上的凹陷、切跡或摺痕（nuclear indentation/convolution），染色質中度濃縮，無顆粒，這些特點提示 T 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Clusters of medium-sized blasts with very high N:C ratio
Nuclear clefts, indentations and convolutions (arrows)
Moderately condensed to finely stippled chromatin with indistinct nucleoli
Scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm, focally as small tufts
Nuclear molding between adjacent blasts
1858.describe_en: Smear shows cohesive-appearing clusters of medium-sized blasts with a very high N:C ratio, moderately condensed chromatin and indistinct nucleoli. Many nuclei show clefts, indentations or convoluted contours (arrows), and the scant cytoplasm is pale blue and agranular. No Auer rods are seen. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia, and the convoluted nuclei are suggestive of T-lineage; confirmation requires flow cytometry for cytoplasmic CD3, TdT, CD7 and CD1a.

ddx.vs: B-lymphoblasts are morphologically indistinguishable in many cases, so lineage is assigned by flow cytometry (CD19/CD79a/CD22 versus cytoplasmic CD3).

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts are agranular but express CD13/CD33/CD117 and lack cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT.
These mature T cells have dense chromatin with cerebriform or flower-like nuclei and are TdT and CD34 negative.

1474.recognize_zh: 這是間期細胞核（DAPI 藍色）的螢光原位雜交（FISH）影像：可見一個單獨紅色訊號、一個單獨綠色訊號，以及一個紅綠緊鄰融合的黃色訊號（1R1G1F），在 CML 的 BCR::ABL1 探針中代表存在一個融合基因。
features: Interphase FISH of a single nucleus counterstained with DAPI (blue)
One isolated red signal and one isolated green (aqua-green) signal
One juxtaposed red-green fusion signal (yellow/overlapping) at the lower right
Signal pattern 1R1G1F, consistent with one BCR::ABL1 fusion using a dual-color single-fusion probe design
1474.describe_en: Interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization image of a DAPI-counterstained nucleus shows one separate red signal, one separate green signal and one juxtaposed red-green fusion signal (1R1G1F). With a dual-color BCR/ABL1 probe, this pattern indicates one normal ABL1 allele, one normal BCR allele and one BCR::ABL1 fusion, consistent with t(9;22)(q34;q11.2). A dual-fusion probe would instead be expected to show two fusion signals in a typical translocation, so the probe design should be confirmed before interpretation. Findings support a diagnosis of chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, in the appropriate context.

60930.recognize_zh: 中央有一個與紅血球差不多大、無核、充滿紫色顆粒且邊緣呈毛邊狀的結構，周圍一般血小板都很小，可判斷為巨大血小板（giant platelet）。
features: Central anucleate platelet approximately the size of adjacent red cells
Dense purple granules throughout with a finely fimbriated, irregular outline
Numerous scattered normal-sized small platelets for size comparison
A pale, round, faintly blue-grey cell at the top center, likely a polychromatophilic red cell
Background normocytic, normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
60930.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with scattered small platelets and an occasional polychromatophilic red cell. In the center is an anucleate platelet approximately equal in diameter to the adjacent red cells, with densely packed purple granules and a fimbriated border. No leukocytes or platelet clumps are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a giant platelet; clinical correlation with platelet count, MPV and history is recommended.

ddx.vs: A lymphocyte has a round dense nucleus surrounded by a thin rim of blue cytoplasm, whereas this structure is anucleate and diffusely granular.
Overlap shows a normal small platelet on top of a red cell with the red cell outline visible beneath, not an isolated red-cell-sized platelet.
A basophil is larger with a lobated nucleus beneath coarse dark granules and a defined cell membrane rather than a fimbriated platelet edge.

130.recognize_zh: 脾臟紅髓內有邊界清楚的病灶，由互相吻合、充滿血液的血管腔構成，腔內有乳頭狀突起，內襯細胞高而肥大並有脫落進腔內的細胞；免疫染色顯示內襯細胞同時帶有內皮與組織球標記（CD68/CD163 類顆粒狀陽性），而正常脾竇才有的 CD8 在病灶內消失，符合 littoral cell angioma。
features: Well-circumscribed red pulp lesion of anastomosing, blood-filled vascular channels of variable caliber, sharply separated from adjacent white pulp
Papillary projections and pseudopapillary tufts protruding into cyst-like vascular lumina
Channels lined by plump, tall (hobnail-like) cells with ovoid bland nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm; occasional desquamated lining cells float in lumina
No significant nuclear atypia, solid spindle-cell areas or mitotic activity in the fields shown

Lining cells express vascular and histiocytic markers (granular CD68/CD163-type staining, including sloughed cells), while the lesion lacks the CD8-positive sinus lattice seen in adjacent normal red pulp
130.describe_en: Sections of spleen show a well-demarcated lesion within the red pulp, adjacent to preserved white pulp, composed of anastomosing vascular channels filled with red blood cells, some cystically dilated and containing papillary fronds. At higher power, the channels are lined by plump, tall, bland endothelial-type cells with ovoid nuclei, some of which are shed into the lumina; atypia, mitoses and necrosis are not seen. Immunohistochemistry shows the lining cells to express endothelial markers together with a histiocytic marker with granular cytoplasmic staining, whereas the CD8-positive sinusoidal network of the normal red pulp is absent within the lesion, and a nuclear endothelial marker highlights residual native vessels. Findings are consistent with littoral cell angioma of the spleen.

ddx.vs: Hemangioma has flat, inconspicuous CD34-positive endothelial lining without papillary tufts, hobnail cells or histiocytic (CD68/CD163) coexpression.
Hamartoma consists of disorganized red pulp with CD8-positive sinus lining cells and lacks the CD8-negative, CD68/CD21-positive papillary lining of LCA.
Angiosarcoma shows infiltrative dissecting channels lined by atypical multilayered cells with mitoses, necrosis and solid areas, unlike the bland lining cells of LCA.

SANT forms multiple angiomatoid nodules with a mixture of CD34+/CD8-, CD34-/CD8+ and CD34-/CD31+ vessels set in fibrosclerotic stroma, rather than uniform papillary channels with histiocytic marker expression.

captions: H&E low power: preserved white pulp (left) adjacent to a lesion of blood-filled anastomosing channels (right)
H&E: cyst-like and anastomosing vascular spaces filled with red cells and bordered by cellular septa
H&E medium power: papillary tufts projecting into a blood-filled lumen
H&E high power: anastomosing channels lined by plump bland cells with some desquamated cells in lumina
IHC (membranous vascular/littoral marker): strong staining of lining cells in the lesion, adjacent white pulp negative
Nuclear IHC (likely ERG or WT1): positive nuclei in native vessel endothelium; lesional cells in lumina largely negative
IHC likely CD8: normal red pulp sinus lattice positive (bottom) contrasted with a lesion lacking sinus staining (top), scattered positive lymphocytes
Endothelial IHC (likely CD34/CD31): small vessels and larger channel walls highlighted at the interface with white pulp
Histiocytic IHC (CD68/CD163-type): granular staining of lining cells and clusters of sloughed cells in a lumen
IHC highlighting the lining of anastomosing blood-filled channels at low power
IHC with membranous staining of clustered cells along channels (possibly CD21 or langerin)

66.recognize_zh: 肝臟切片可見肝竇（sinusoid）與匯管區內浸潤大量單核球樣與顆粒球系列細胞，肝細胞板被推擠；脾臟紅髓瀰漫擴張，充滿不成熟骨髓單核球細胞。免疫染色只見少數散在母細胞陽性，符合幼兒肝脾腫大的幼年型骨髓單核球白血病（JMML）髓外浸潤。
features: Liver, low power: portal tracts and sinusoids diffusely infiltrated by hematopoietic cells in a sinusoidal pattern, with preserved hepatocyte plates
Liver, high power: sinusoidal infiltrate of monocytoid cells with oval to indented nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, admixed with maturing granulocytes, band forms and occasional erythroid precursors
Spleen: red pulp diffusely expanded by a mixed population of monocytoid cells, immature and maturing granulocytes and interspersed red cells
IHC (unlabeled marker): cytoplasmic granular staining of numerous infiltrating myelomonocytic cells in the splenic/hepatic infiltrate
IHC (unlabeled markers): one stain outlines the sinusoidal infiltrate; another highlights only scattered single cells plus vessel walls, consistent with a low blast count
66.describe_en: Sections of liver show a diffuse sinusoidal and portal infiltrate of hematopoietic cells that expands the sinusoids while the hepatocyte plates are preserved. At high power the infiltrate consists of monocytoid cells with oval to indented nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, admixed with maturing granulocytes and occasional nucleated red cells. The spleen shows diffuse expansion of the red pulp by a similar mixed myelomonocytic population. Immunohistochemistry (markers not labeled in the figure) shows granular cytoplasmic staining of many infiltrating cells and, on a separate stain, only scattered positive single cells, supporting a low blast proportion without sheets of blasts. In a 3-year-old with hepatosplenomegaly, findings are consistent with extramedullary involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia; confirmation requires peripheral blood monocytosis and RAS-pathway genetic studies.

ddx.vs: EMH shows trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and erythroid islands rather than a monocyte-predominant myelomonocytic infiltrate, and lacks peripheral monocytosis or RAS-pathway mutations.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation (myeloid sarcoma)
ddx.vs: AML/myeloid sarcoma forms sheets of blasts or promonocytes with at least 20% blasts, whereas here the blast-marker stain highlights only scattered cells within a maturing infiltrate.
HLH shows sinusoidal histiocytes with engulfed erythrocytes and lymphocytes rather than a proliferation of immature and maturing granulocytic and monocytic cells.
Infection can cause hepatosplenomegaly and monocytosis, so the distinction relies on viral studies and demonstration of PTPN11, KRAS, NRAS, NF1 or CBL alterations or monosomy 7.

captions: IHC (marker unlabeled): granular cytoplasmic staining of numerous infiltrating myelomonocytic cells
Liver, low power: diffuse sinusoidal and portal infiltrate
Liver, high power: sinusoidal infiltrate of monocytoid and granulocytic cells
Liver, higher power: monocytoid cells with indented nuclei and maturing granulocytes in sinusoids
Liver IHC (marker unlabeled): staining outlining the sinusoidal infiltrate
Liver IHC (marker unlabeled): only scattered positive single cells and vessel walls
Spleen: red pulp expanded by myelomonocytic cells
Spleen, high power: mixed immature and maturing myelomonocytic cells in red pulp

2.recognize_zh: 血液與骨髓抹片可見大量母細胞，且有兩種大小：小型、染色質較緻密、細胞質極少的淋巴母細胞樣細胞，以及較大、染色質細緻、核仁明顯、細胞質較多的母細胞；骨髓切片為瀰漫母細胞取代。形態上無法確定系別，需靠流式與免疫染色證實 B/T 雙系及 BCR::ABL1。
features: PB: circulating blasts of intermediate to large size with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm, alongside a mature neutrophil

BM aspirate: marked increase in blasts with a dimorphic appearance: smaller blasts with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm and larger blasts with finely dispersed chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate pale-blue cytoplasm
Blast nuclei round to irregular or indented; no Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules evident
BM biopsy: hypercellular marrow diffusely replaced by sheets of monotonous blasts with scattered residual erythroid precursors
Occasional maturing granulocytes present, without basophilia or myeloid left-shifted maturation typical of CML in the fields shown
2.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm. The bone marrow aspirate is replaced by blasts that appear heterogeneous in size, including small lymphoblast-like cells with scant cytoplasm and larger blasts with dispersed chromatin, nucleoli and moderate cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen. The trephine biopsy is hypercellular with diffuse sheets of blasts and marked reduction of normal hematopoiesis. Lineage cannot be assigned morphologically; flow cytometry and immunohistochemistry demonstrate discrete B-lymphoblastic and T-lymphoblastic populations, and cytogenetics show t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) with BCR::ABL1 fusion. Findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/T, with t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2); BCR::ABL1.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, but flow cytometry shows a single B-lineage blast population without a separate cytoplasmic CD3+/CD1a+ T-lymphoblast population.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in lymphoid blast phase
ddx.vs: History or residual chronic-phase features (basophilia, myeloid left shift, small hypolobated megakaryocytes) favor CML blast phase, which is excluded before diagnosing MPAL.
Shows only a T-lineage blast population and typically lacks t(9;22), whereas here a distinct B-lineage population coexists.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Blasts are MPO-negative by morphology too, but flow shows CD13/CD33/CD117 with MPO by flow in a subset and no lymphoid lineage-defining markers.

captions: Peripheral blood: circulating blasts with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Bone marrow aspirate: dimorphic blast population of small and larger blasts
Bone marrow biopsy: diffuse sheets of blasts replacing the marrow

65218.recognize_zh: 淋巴結被瀰漫的大型淋巴細胞取代（A），免疫染色大片 CD7、CD8 及 PAX5 陽性，但 CD3 只剩散在的反應性 T 細胞、CD20 完全陰性；流式顯示 CD8 陽性、CD3/CD19/輕鏈陰性，而 IGH 與 IGK 基因重組為單株峰，證明這是帶有異常 T 細胞標記的 B 細胞（Richter 轉化）。
features: H&E (A): diffuse sheets of large lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei, visible nucleoli and moderate cytoplasm
IHC: diffuse CD7 (B) and CD8 (C) and strong nuclear PAX5 (E); CD3 (D) only in scattered small reactive T cells; CD20 (F) negative
Flow (G): large-FSC population CD8-positive, CD3-negative, CD19-negative and lacking surface kappa/lambda
PCR fragment analysis (H): dominant clonal peaks in IGH FR2-JH (~278 bp) and IGK Vk-Jk (~289 bp)
65218.describe_en: Lymph node biopsy shows diffuse effacement by sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli. By immunohistochemistry, the large cells are positive for PAX5, CD7 and CD8 and negative for CD3 and CD20, with CD3 highlighting only scattered background T cells. Flow cytometry shows a CD8-positive population lacking CD3, CD19 and surface light chains, and PCR demonstrates clonal IGH and IGK rearrangements identical to the prior CLL/SLL clone, with no TRG rearrangement. Findings are consistent with Richter transformation to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with aberrant T-cell antigen (CD7, CD8) expression and loss of CD20.

ddx.vs: PTCL is usually surface/cytoplasmic CD3-positive, PAX5-negative and shows clonal TR rearrangement, whereas these cells are CD3-negative, PAX5-positive with clonal IG rearrangements.
CD20 loss after rituximab retains PAX5, whereas plasmablastic lymphoma loses PAX5 and expresses CD138/MUM1; neither expresses CD8/CD7 as here.
Hodgkin-type transformation has scattered CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background rather than CD30-negative sheets of large B cells.
Only clonal comparison of IG rearrangements with the prior CLL separates them; here the clones were identical.

65218.stain: H&E, IHC: CD7, CD8, CD3, PAX5, CD20; flow cytometry; IG PCR

60226.recognize_zh: 紅血球比旁邊的小淋巴球還小，而且中央蒼白區極大，只剩一圈細細的血紅素邊緣（ring-like），並有鉛筆狀與不規則變形紅血球，背景血小板增加；這是嚴重缺鐵性貧血（iron deficiency anemia）的抹片。
features: Profoundly hypochromic red cells with only a thin peripheral rim of hemoglobin (ring forms)
Microcytosis, many red cells smaller than the nucleus of the adjacent small lymphocyte
Marked poikilocytosis including pencil/elongated cells, teardrop-like and irregular fragmented forms
Low red cell density consistent with severe anemia
Increased platelets scattered in the background; normal small lymphocyte for size comparison
60226.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a markedly reduced red cell density with profound hypochromia, the red cells appearing as thin rims of hemoglobin surrounding large areas of central pallor. The red cells are microcytic, with many smaller than the nucleus of a normal small lymphocyte, and show marked poikilocytosis including elongated pencil cells and irregular forms. Platelets are increased. Target cells, basophilic stippling, and nucleated red cells are not evident. Findings are consistent with severe iron deficiency anemia with reactive thrombocytosis.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia trait has milder anemia with a disproportionately low MCV, a high RBC count, target cells and basophilic stippling, and normal ferritin.
Usually normocytic or only mildly microcytic with far less hypochromia and poikilocytosis, and ferritin is normal or high.
Shows a dimorphic red cell population with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts in the marrow with increased, not absent, iron stores.
Features coarse basophilic stippling with mild microcytosis and elevated blood lead.

62722.recognize_zh: 這是 WHO 2016 混合表型急性白血病（MPAL）的譜系指定準則表格：骨髓系看 MPO 或單核球分化、T 系看細胞質 CD3、B 系看強 CD19 加上 CD79a、cCD22、CD10 其一；表中螢光標示 MPO、強 CD19 與 CD79a，代表本病例屬 B/骨髓系。
features: Table summarizing WHO 2016 criteria for assigning more than one lineage to a single blast population
Myeloid lineage: MPO (flow, IHC, or cytochemistry) or monocytic differentiation (at least 2 of NSE, CD11c, CD14, CD64, lysozyme)
T-cell lineage: cytoplasmic CD3 by flow (CD3 epsilon) or surface CD3; polyclonal IHC CD3 may detect non-specific zeta chain
B-cell lineage: strong CD19 with at least 1 strong of CD79a, cCD22, CD10; or weak CD19 with at least 2 of these
Highlighted items (MPO, strong CD19, CD79a) indicate the markers satisfied in the index B/myeloid case
62722.describe_en: This figure is a reference table, not a morphologic image, listing the WHO 2016 immunophenotypic requirements for assigning myeloid, T-cell, and B-cell lineage to a blast population. Myeloid lineage requires MPO or evidence of monocytic differentiation; T-cell lineage requires cytoplasmic or surface CD3; B-cell lineage requires strong CD19 with one additional strong B-cell marker, or weak CD19 with two. The highlighted markers (MPO, strong CD19, and CD79a) show that the blasts in the reference case fulfill both myeloid and B-cell criteria. These findings support a diagnosis of mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid, NOS, after exclusion of defining genetic abnormalities such as BCR::ABL1 and KMT2A rearrangement.
